Permanent Weekend Job Saturday and Sunday – Driving and Cleaning – Dianalund / Central and West Zealand

We are looking for a reliable and responsible employee for a permanent weekend position involving cleaning and driving between various commercial locations across Central and West Zealand.

The position is 8-8.5 hours every Saturday and 8-8.5 hours every Sunday, for a total of 16-17 hours per week.

Working hours are generally 07:00–15:00, but the schedule can also be arranged to start earlier or later in the day by agreement.

About the job

Your working day will start and finish in Dianalund, from where you will drive a planned route between different commercial locations.

The route includes areas such as Roskilde, Holbæk, Sorø and Slagelse.

All driving related to the job is carried out in a company vehicle, which is used throughout the entire route from the start of the working day in Dianalund until the route is completed back in Dianalund.

The job consists approximately of:

  • 65% driving between the different locations

  • 35% cleaning at the commercial sites

The cleaning tasks include general commercial cleaning, such as cleaning toilets, floors and common areas, as well as refilling consumable supplies.

We expect that you

  • Have a valid Category B driving licence

  • Are reliable, punctual and responsible

  • Are able to work independently

  • Can follow a planned route and work schedule

  • Take pride in delivering good-quality work

  • Are comfortable spending a large part of the working day driving

  • Are available to work regularly on both Saturdays and Sundays

Previous cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement, as training will be provided.

We offer

  • Good salary and employment conditions

  • A permanent weekend position of 16-17 hours per week

  • Regular work every Saturday and Sunday

  • A company vehicle for all driving related to the job

  • Flexibility in scheduling working hours by agreement

  • A high degree of independence and responsibility

  • A varied working day combining driving and practical cleaning tasks

  • A planned and manageable route

  • Thorough training when you start

  • Stable working conditions with the possibility of long-term employment

  • Possibility of additional hours when available and agreed

  • An informal working environment focused on reliability, quality and good cooperation

Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, generally 07:00–15:00
Working area: Central and West Zealand
Start and finish location: Dianalund
Starting date: By agreement

If this position sounds like a good fit for you, please send us a short application with some information about yourself, your work experience and when you would be available to start.

title: Norwegian or Swedish speaking insurance sales agent (Norwegian market)
description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?
- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!

Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.

It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone. It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.


Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job
 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.

- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

 

Who are we and what do we do?
Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

title: Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about Embedded Linux and eager to make a real impact across industries? Join Prevas as an Embedded Linux Engineer and Consultant, helping our clients navigate technology transitions, ensure product security, and build new embedded solutions for a safer, smarter world. Whether you come from a consultancy background or have experience as a technical leader in product development, this could be your next step.

About the Role: Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

As part of our team, you will collaborate with a wide variety of organizations – from global enterprises to innovative startups. Your main focus will be on embedded Linux development, secure firmware, and technical consulting. You will play an essential role in supporting our clients as they develop, update, and secure their embedded systems, particularly in response to evolving security standards and regulations.

Key Responsibilities in Embedded Linux Engineering & Consulting

  • Design, develop, and optimize embedded Linux software for various hardware platforms.

  • Work closely with our skilled engineers and customers.

Desirable: Additional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate on hardware root-of-trust, secure boot, and chain-of-trust implementations.

  • Assist in system hardening, configuration for security, encryption, and access control mechanisms and embedded patch management.

What We’re Looking For: Skills & Experience in Embedded Linux.

  • Background in software development and embedded systems, specifically with Linux.

  • Ability to work with Linux both in user and kernel space.

  • Experience working with Yocto

  • Structured, analytical, and reliable approach to problem solving.

  • Excellent English communication and writing skills, able to convey technical detail concisely and clearly.

Desirable: Additional Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, software lifecycle management, or security architecture (from any industry – embedded, medical, IT, defense, etc.).

  • Experience working with security standards – e.g. IEC 62443-4-1/2, IEC 81001-5-1, ETSI EN 303 645, EN 18031, ISO 27001.

  • Hands-on experience with secure software development technologies such as secure bootloaders, encrypted data storage, threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE), and system authentication methods.

Why Join Prevas? Career Growth in Embedded Linux & Consulting

  • Be part of a dynamic team where you work closely with experts who value problem solving, personal growth, and technical passion.

  • Opportunities to influence product security strategies in real-world projects.

  • Work with a great mix of industries and customers – from large corporations to dynamic startups.

  • Create lasting impact in both products and organizations through your consulting work.

About Prevas: Engineering Excellence in Embedded Linux & Electronics

At Prevas, embedded technology is at our core. Over the last 40 years, we have completed more than 5,000 development projects across software and electronics. We see development as a natural part of life – from idea to product, and from career to personal growth. Our open, inclusive atmosphere provides you with the space to be yourself and develop your ideas, while working across disciplines with dedicated colleagues.

If you share our passion for problem-solving, teamwork, and learning, and you want to help shape the future of embedded systems and secure IoT solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Contact Us

For more information or an informal conversation about the role, please contact VP Technology Peter Aagaard Kristensen at +45 51 54 33 66. You can also find out more about us on our website and LinkedIn page.

We look forward to welcoming you to Prevas – where every day is a chance to build something great together.

title: Operations Manager- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Looking for an Operations Manager role where you can genuinely make your mark? As a key member of our leadership team, you'll balance strategic thinking with a hands-on approach, empowering teams, improving the guest experience, and driving operational excellence across the house.

What makes this role unique? Your impact. At Zoku, decisions are made close to the operation, ideas are welcomed, and leaders are trusted to take ownership. As a growing company, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, develop your leadership skills, and influence decisions that directly impact both the business and the people around you.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of business hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

As our Operations Manager, you'll be responsible for the smooth running of Zoku Copenhagen's day-to-day operations while safeguarding the unique Zoku guest experience. You'll lead our Front of House operation, including Front Office, F&B Services and Co-working, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the warm and welcoming atmosphere we're known for.

Forget everything you know about a traditional hotel reception. At Zoku, you'll oversee our vibrant social spaces, including the Kindred Spirits bar, Living Kitchen restaurant, co-working areas, and rooftop terrace. Together with your teams, you'll create memorable experiences for our guests while continuously looking for opportunities to improve operational excellence.

Beyond Front of House, you'll act as a key connector across the business. Working closely with our Maintenance, Housekeeping, People & Culture, Kitchen, Meeting & Events and Support Office teams, you'll ensure seamless collaboration and help keep all moving parts aligned.

Of course, you won't be doing this alone. You'll lead and develop a team of Duty Managers and Sidekicks, providing coaching, support and guidance while helping them grow both professionally and personally.

As a valued member of the Management Team, you'll work closely with and report directly to the General Manager. Together, you'll drive performance, lead operational improvements and ensure Zoku Copenhagen continues to be a place where both guests and colleagues feel at home.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?
No day looks the same as an Operations Manager… but here’s a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Operational coach: Guide, train and manage our operational team, including organizing regular check-ins and quarterly goal setting.

  • Smooth operator: Be hands-on and actively support the operational team to make sure that every guest receives a Zoku-like experience. You'll jump in when and where needed without hesitation - you lead by example.

  • Above & Beyond: Find creative ways & opportunities to increase our financial results and revenue streams as well as team engagement and guest satisfaction.

  • Keep your admin in check: Whether it's our PMS, POS or SOP's, you stay on top of our systems and processes, and organize our data & suppliers efficiently. 

  • Guardian of our values: Uphold Zoku's brand standards and ensure that team is always up-to-date.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • A market conform salary package in accordance with experience and know-how.

  • Leadership training and coaching to support your professional growth and leadership development.

  • Cool benefits like a free after-work drink, various discounts and friends & family rates at all Zoku locations.

  • A fun, young, multi-national company with colleagues from across the globe to meet, learn and grow with. 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our social spaces overlooking the city. 

  • Exciting (on the job) training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO

  • Bring good vibes to the work floor

  • Are genuinely friendly, approachable, and empathetic.

  • Show strong leadership skills and know how to empower and grow their team.

  • Can juggle many tasks at once while remaining cool-headed and warm-hearted.

  • Have an entrepreneurial spirit and never settle for less than amazing.

  • Have worked in an international workplace.

  • Have provable knowledge of maintaining a high standard of guest service and team engagement.


A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You speak fluent Danish and English.

  • You have a minimum of 3 years working experience leading operational teams in the Front Office and/or Food and Beverage department.

  • You’ve worked with PMS and POS software.

  • You are an EU-resident or have a valid Danish working permit.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days/hours.

  • You love to work as we'll need you full time.

description:
MIG/MAG keevitus -> rasketehnika /hüdrosilindrid

Tööülesanded: Sinu igapäevased kangelasteod:

Rasketehnika masti ja detailide keevitus: mõrad- faasimine/keevitus. Ja palju muud... Meeskonna toetamine defekteerimisel ja masinate lahtivõtmisel. Töö on mitmekülgne ja eriprojekte on palju. Võimalus õppida juurde lihtsamat treitööd! Sellel teekonnal on toeks kogu meeskond, sest tihti hõlmab masina või hüdrosilindri remont mitut etappi: -Lahtivõtt ja defekteerimine -Pakkumise tegemine/eeldatavad töötunnid projektile -Tööde planeerimine -Võimalikud treitööd -Materjalide tellimine -Keevitus/kooste -Avade taastamine -Sirgestus -Uute detailide valmistamine /tellimine -Joonestamine -Hooldus -Montaaž See on ülevaade kogu meeskonna tööst! Kui oled meeskonnamängija, siis see üldsegi mitte igav ja mitmekülgne töö võib olla just Sulle! Me ei eelda, et Sa oskad kõike. Kui Sul on suur huvi rasketehnika ja metallitööde vastu, siis see on juba kõige olulisem. Kuulutuses märgitud palk ei ole ülempiir- see on meie miinimum. Initsiatiiv+motivatsioon+tööde teostamise kiirus= kõrgem palk! Kui soovid täpsemat tööde kirjeldust, siis helista või tule kohale meiega tutvuma!

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt on Sulle tasuta lõuna.
Maksame isikliku sõiduauto kompensatsiooni. Palk kuni 3500 € bruto. Kui planeerid ja teed oma tööd eriti hästi ja efektiivselt, tulevad mängu boonused – ehk siis 3500 € ei ole lagi! Hästi varustatud töökoda ja toetav tiim, kes hindab head nalja sama kõrgelt kui kvaliteetselt remonditud tehnikat.

Muud nõuded: Mida me Sinult ootame
Põhioskused: MIG/MAG keevitus. Oled eelisjärjekorras kui: Sul on varasem reaalne kokkupuude rasketehnika hooldusega, teadmised hüdraulikast, hüdrosilindritest ning tunned metalli ja selle töötlemist. Kuldne tase: kui oskad vahetada hüdrosilindril tihendid täiesti iseseisvalt ja seda ka testida/stendida (220bar). Oled meil kohe nimekirja tipus! Lisapunktid: TIG keevitus ja elektrood ning oskus teha lihtsamaid treitöid manuaalsel treipingil annavad sulle tugeva eelise. Võidab siiski kirg rasketehnika vastu ja soov/tahe töötada metalliga!

description:
.

Work tasks: Main Duties
• Prepare and cook a wide range of restaurant products, including savory and sweet dishes, baked products, pastries, dough products, fillings, sauces, soups, salads, desserts, and meat and fish dishes, according to established recipes and standards. • Prepare, roll, stretch, layer, fill, and handle dough and ensure consistent taste, texture, portioning, appearance, and presentation of finished products. • Organize and coordinate daily kitchen production, monitor product availability and workflow, adjust production when necessary, and maintain quality while minimizing waste. • Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. • Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, kitchen and production activities, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. • Prepare and coordinate daily, weekly, and monthly operational plans, including staffing, production, inventory, cleaning, maintenance, and other recurring requirements. • Monitor stock, ingredients, expiration dates, deliveries, inventory, write-offs, storage, and waste, and assist with ordering and stocktaking. • Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. • Guide, supervise, train, and support cooks and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. • Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth kitchen and restaurant operations. • Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. • Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. • Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. • Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. • Manage and participate in recipe implementation, menu and product development, testing, new-product introduction, and continuous improvement. • Identify operational or employee-performance deficiencies, take appropriate corrective action within assigned authority, and report significant issues to the Manager. • Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations. • Where specifically authorized and assigned in writing by the Employer, assume designated operational and supervisory responsibilities during the Manager’s absence.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring cooks, servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Good knowledge of food safety, hygiene, allergen management, cleanliness, occupational health and safety, and general restaurant operating requirements. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, trustworthy, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

Tööülesanded: Majapidaja/toateenindaja vastutab külalistubade, heaolualade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide puhtuse, korra ning esindusliku välimuse eest.
Töö on füüsiline ning eeldab valmisolekut tõsta ja liigutada kuni 20 kg kaaluvaid esemeid, seadmeid ja töövahendeid. Laupäev on tavapärase töögraafiku osa. Peamised tööülesanded Külalistoad Külalistubade ettevalmistamine, koristamine ja hooldamine Eha töö-, tervise- ja ohutusnõuete kohaselt. Külaliste privaatsuse austamine ja nende isiklike esemete hoolikas käsitlemine. Hooldusvajadustest viivitamata teavitamine. Probleemidest, külaliste soovidest ja pooleliolevatest töödest majapidamisjuhi teavitamine. Heaolualad ja ühiskasutatavad ruumid Heaoluruumide, hoolitsustubade, termiliste alade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide koristamine ning korrashoid. Ruumide puhtuse, hügieeni ja külaliste ohutuse tagamine. Ruumide ettevalmistamine ja taastamine vastavalt päevakavale. Akende puhastamine iganädalase graafiku alusel. Pesumajandus ja voodipesu Pesu kogumine, sorteerimine ja töötlemine kehtestatud töökorra kohaselt. Voodipesu nõuetekohane käsitlemine ja korrastamine. Tervis, ohutus ja hügieen Töötervishoiu- ja ohutusnõuete järgimine. Puhastusvahendite ja -seadmete korrektne kasutamine. Hooldusprobleemidest, ohuteguritest ja puudustest viivitamata teavitamine. Majapidamiskäru ja laoruumide puhta ning korrastatuna hoidmine. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö Tõhus suhtlemine majapidamisjuhi ja teiste kolleegidega. Täpse teabe edastamine tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. Koostöö kolleegidega sujuva igapäevase töökorralduse tagamiseks. Professionaalse ja lugupidava käitumise säilitamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: Brutotasu 1 300 - 1 500 EUR kuus.
Põhjalikku väljaõpet ja tuge sisseelamisel. Tasuta toitlustust igal tööpäeval. Eha poolt vajalikke tööriideid. Transporti või sõidukompensatsiooni vastavalt kokkuleppele. Abi sobiva kohaliku majutuskoha leidmisel. Eha töötajatele majutust ei paku. Toetavaid töötingimusi ja professionaalse arengu võimalusi. Meeskonnakultuuri, kus sinu panust siiralt hinnatakse. Võimalust aidata Eha Retreati majapidamisstandardeid algusest peale kujundada. Selget võimalust kasvada koos Ehaga. Rollis arenedes ja oma võimekust näidates saad võtta rohkem vastutust, panustada majapidamisprotseduuride täiustamisse ning meeskonna kasvades liikuda edasi majapidamistööde juhendaja rolli.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sinult:
igapäevaseks töösuhtluseks vajalikku kirjalikku ja suulist inglise keele oskust, sest kohapealse meeskonna töökeel on inglise keel; võimet töötada kõrgete puhtus- ja hügieenistandardite järgi; head ajaplaneerimis- ja organiseerimisoskust; tähelepanu detailidele ja järjepidevust; oskust töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas; usaldusväärset, professionaalset ja lugupidavat suhtumist; valmisolekut füüsiliseks tööks ning kuni 20 kg raskuste tõstmiseks ja liigutamiseks; võimalust töötada teisipäevast laupäevani; soovi õppida ja oma rollis areneda. Varasem majapidamis-, koristus-, hotelli-, spaa- või külalislahkuse valdkonna kogemus on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. Vajalik väljaõpe toimub kohapeal.

title: Sähkö ja hybridiajoneuvojen huoltoteknikko
description:
Haemme osaavaa sähkö ja hybridiajoneuvojen huoltoteknikkoa osaksi ammattitaitoista tiimiämme.

Työtehtävässä keskityt erityisesti sähkö ja hybridiajoneuvojen korkeajännitejärjestelmien huoltoon, diagnostiikkaan ja korjauksiin. Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluu monipuolisesti nykyaikaisten henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustöitä.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa

- Akku ja voimansiirtojärjestelmien tarkastus, huolto ja vianmääritys

- Sähkömoottorien, inverttereiden sekä latausjärjestelmien diagnostiikka

- Ajoneuvojen vikakoodien ja järjestelmien tutkiminen OBD-diagnostiikkalaitteilla sekä valmistajakohtaisilla ohjelmistoilla

- Mekaaniset huolto ja korjaustyöt, kuten jarru- ja alustakorjaukset

- Tarvittaessa autosähköön liittyvät korjaus- ja asennustyöt

- Korkeajännitejärjestelmien turvallisuusohjeiden ja työmenetelmien noudattaminen

- Oman teknisen osaamisen aktiivinen ylläpitäminen ja kehittäminen


Odotamme sinulta

- Sähköajoneuvoalaan soveltuvaa koulutusta tai vahvaa käytännön kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä

- Kokemusta sähkö ja hybridiajoneuvojen huollosta katsotaan eduksi

- Hyvää diagnostiikkalaitteiden, mittausvälineiden ja sähkökaavioiden hallintaa

- Valmiutta itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä vastuullista otetta vaativiin korjaustöihin

- Tehtävässä tarvittavia voimassa olevia pätevyyksiä ja todistuksia

- B-ajokorttia

- Huolellista ja turvallisuuslähtöistä työskentelytapaa sekä asianmukaisten suojavarusteiden käyttöä


Tarjoamme

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:

Kunnossapitoasentajana työtehtäviisi kuuluu erilaisia teollisuuslaitteiden huoltoa, kunnossapitoa ja korjausta teollisuusalan yrityksissä. Reissutyön luonteen vuoksi työaika on joustava. Työt alkavat sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

- Valmiutta liikkuvaan työhön

title: ASRO: Jr. Project Manager, space microscope projects
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you excited about coordinating complex space projects and growing into a project management role? Join ASRO and help take space instrumentation from development to launch!

**Your role with us**

As a Junior Project Manager at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will join the microscope business area and support the project management of space projects. The projects focus on further developing ASROs microscope technology and platform, with missions currently planned for low Earth orbit and the Moon.

Working closely with the Business Area Director, you will help keep multidisciplinary development projects moving forward. Your responsibilities include coordinating schedules and meetings, tracking project actions and deadlines, and ensuring that the documentation and data packages are prepared according to the project requirements and on time.

You will work with experts across mechanics, electronics, software and optics, as well as with ESA, research partners, universities and suppliers. You may also coordinate component purchasing and help maintain project management tools such as Jira. As you gain experience, the role offers room to take on broader responsibilities and grow towards independently managing projects. **What makes you a great fit?**

You might be at the beginning of your career and motivated to grow into a project management professional in a highly technical environment. You enjoy working with people, bringing structure to complex projects and making sure things keep moving forward.

You do not need to be an experienced Project Manager – at least not yet! What matters most is a proactive approach, curiosity toward technical systems, and the confidence to take ownership. You are also comfortable working in a growing and evolving organization, where your role can develop as you gain experience and take on more responsibility.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Some previous work experience, for example through internships, project work, or other relevant roles.

- Interest in coordinating complex technical projects and keeping schedules, actions and documentation on track

- A proactive and organized working style with the willingness to take ownership and learn

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Previous exposure to the space industry through studies, projects or work experience is a huge advantage

- Experience in project-based or multidisciplinary engineering environments

- Familiarity with Jira or other project management tools

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Grow into a project management role by taking on real responsibility in ambitious space projects, supported by experienced colleagues.

- Build broad technical understanding by working closely with specialists across mechanics, electronics, software and optics.

- See your work directly support space missions from development and launch all the way to the Moon.

- Shape your responsibilities as you develop, with room to gradually take ownership of increasingly complex project management tasks.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role may also include occasional travel, typically a few trips per year depending on the project.

Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4000 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your background, potential, and the amount of relevant expertise you bring to the role. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386694/create/.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. For more information about ASRO, visit **https://asro.fi/**. For details about the profile & recruitment process, contact Senior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as I can.

title: ASRO: Project Manager, space radiation instrument projects
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Lemminkäisenkatu 46, 20520 Turku

**Application deadline**: 13.10.2026

Are you ready to take ownership of technically demanding space projects and work closely with customers from development to delivery and beyond? Join ASRO and help bring Finnish space technology to customers around the world!

**Your role with us**

As a **Project Manager** at Aboa Space Research (ASRO), you will take responsibility for projects within ASROs space weather business area. Your focus will be on space radiation instruments, with several ongoing projects ranging from instrument deliveries to concept studies. You can read more about ASROs space weather monitoring solutions here.

You will independently manage typically one to three projects at a time, coordinating the work of multidisciplinary engineering teams and keeping schedules, deliverables, resources, and stakeholders aligned. You will follow project progress, make sure agreed actions move forward, and keep customers up to date throughout the project. Depending on the project, your work may range from managing straightforward instrument deliveries to coordinating more exploratory development where the technical solution is still taking shape.

Your role will also extend beyond traditional project management. You will work closely with customers, ESA, subcontractors and ASROs multidisciplinary engineering teams, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and technical development. As projects move from development to delivery, you may also continue working with customers around instrument data and future needs, as well as identify opportunities for follow-up projects. The exact scope can be shaped around your background and strengths.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have experience managing technical projects and are comfortable taking ownership of complex projects involving both engineering teams and external customers. A technical background helps you understand what is happening beneath the project plan and work effectively with specialists across different disciplines.

At the same time, you are not looking for a narrowly defined Project Manager role. ASRO is a small and evolving company, and you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute where your expertise creates the most value. Depending on your strengths and wishes, in the future your role can also develop towards technical product ownership, broader project portfolio project management responsibilities, or a more customer-facing and commercial direction.

**We hope you have:**

- A Masters or PhD degree in engineering, natural sciences, or another relevant technical field

- Ideally, plus five years of relevant professional experience, including experience in project management or technical project environments

- Experience taking ownership of projects and coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams

- A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with engineering specialists and customers

- Good English skills and confidence working with different internal and external stakeholders


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from the space industry, space instrumentation or other demanding technology environments

- Knowledge of radiation effects, detection technologies, embedded software or data-related solutions

- Experience from product development, product ownership, or bringing technical products into production

- Experience working in a smaller technology company or in customer-facing engineering projects

- Finnish language skills


**What ASRO offers you?**

- Take ownership of ambitious space projects where you can directly influence how projects and customer relationships develop.

- Work with space radiation technology across instrument development, deliveries and emerging data-driven services.

- Use your technical expertise beyond project management, with opportunities to contribute to systems engineering and product development.

- Shape your role in a small organization with minimal hierarchy as ASROs products, customers and business continue to develop.

- Flexible working methods and the possibility of partial remote work

- Healthcare insurance as an employment benefit


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time role, and you will be employed directly by ASRO. The position is based at ASROs office in Turku, and regular on-site presence is important for close collaboration with the project teams. Partial remote work is also possible. The role includes occasional travel to customers and other project stakeholders, typically a few trips per year depending on the projects.

Salary ranges between 4000–6500 €/month, with the final salary determined based on your experience and expertise and your readiness to take independent ownership of space radiation instrument projects. We are also happy to hear about your salary expectations.

**Recruitment process**

- Initial phone interviews with aTalent

- On-site interviews with ASRO


**Interested? Apply now!**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by latest 13th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/386702/create/. In your motivation letter, we would especially like to hear what interested you in this role and ASRO, which aspects of your background and expertise you feel are particularly relevant to the position, and how you would like to develop or shape the role going forward.

Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. title: Data and AI Lead for Corporate Sustainability
description:
Are you passionate about data and AI technology — and excited by the opportunity to turn them into real-world sustainability impact?

Were looking for an ambitious and innovative Data & AI professional to work with us in the intersection of AI and corporate sustainability. Youll play a key role as an AI ambassador in building data & AI performance across our business units, from sustainability SaaS and data & AI products to the consultancy business.

If you want to work where data, AI technology, and sustainability meet — and help shape what comes next — wed love to hear from you.

The role

Were looking for a talented and forward-thinking Data & AI Engineer to help shape the next generation of AI-driven sustainability solutions at Ecobio.

Youll work with our data and AI capabilities end-to-end — from reliable data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and data foundations to machine learning, generative AI, and new AI-enabled products and services.

You are a member of our technology team, and you'll work with nature and sustainability experts, and sales to turn environmental and business challenges into scalable, impactful new solutions.

Beyond building technology, youll help shape and implement our AI strategy and practices, introduce emerging technologies, mentor colleagues, and act as an in-house ambassador for responsible and effective AI adoption.

In this role you will grow into technical owner of data and AI products.

At Ecobio, data and AI are tools for creating business value, solving environmental challenges, and protecting nature for future generations.



What you'll do with us

Build our data foundation — design and maintain data pipelines, integrations, APIs, master data, and data quality across our systems.

Develop new production-grade data and AI solutions — including machine learning, generative AI and taking solutions from prototypes to reliable, scalable SaaS features or specific products.

Leverage cloud and emerging technologies — your experience with Microsoft Azure and all related services highly valued. Experience with MLOps, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD in Azure is considered a strong advantage. Experience from AWS or GCP is also relevant.

Enable trusted data and AI — ensuring our data, interfaces, and AI solutions are reliable, governed, and ready for use by customers and our own experts.

Drive automation and innovation — automate data-intensive processes and continuously explore new ways to apply data and AI.

Collaborate with customers and sustainability colleagues — work with product, development, sustainability, and commercial teams to turn needs into technical solutions.
Grow AI capabilities across Ecobio — share knowledge, mentor colleagues as an AI ambassador, and help advance our responsible and ethical use of AI.


What we hope you bring

* University-level education in data engineering or computer science.

* Understanding about modern AI and agentic products.

* Hands-on several years experience with AI/ML or data solutions (idea to production).

* Data engineering experience including ETL, data lakes, master data and data quality.

* Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

* A learning and innovative mindset — you actively follow developments in data technology and AI.

* A product and customer mindset — you enjoy turning technical capabilities into reliable solutions that create value for customers.

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with confidence working with technical and sustainability colleagues.

* Fluent professional English.

None can do all. If you are confident in any technical issues, and you are a quick learner, please contact us and apply.



What we offer

At Ecobio, youll join a multinational, multidisciplinary team where data technology, AI, and sustainability converge. Youll have the opportunity to grow as an engineer while playing a key role in shaping how data and AI create the future of our products and business.

We offer a full-time position on a skilled, growing team, with our office in Kamppi, Helsinki. We support flexible working hours and remote work, and offer benefits including sports and lunch benefits, as well as a phone benefit.

Your work would start as a key member in our innovative Business Finland project.

Lets work together!



Compensation

The salary range for this position will be discussed during the initial interview. It depends on your background and experience.



How to apply

Please send your application and CV (in Finnish or English) along with your salary expectations by October 15, 2026. We will begin conducting interviews during the application period.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact:

Toni Suominen
Chief Technology Officer
toni.suominen(at)ecobio.fi
Phone: +358 20 765 6146
Available on weekdays 8:00–16:00.

We are Ecobio. The Standard in Corporate Sustainability.



We are Ecobio, the Corporate Sustainability Company. We build up the future.

Today, we combine over 35 years of 60 + sustainability expertise with cutting-edge technology to help organisations future-proof their businesses. By connecting sustainability performance with business value, we enable companies to make better decisions, drive meaningful impact, and build a more sustainable future.



At Ecobio, we strive to create a welcoming and supportive workplace where people can do meaningful work and grow. We value trust, collaboration, well-being, and diverse perspectives, believing that our differences make us stronger.

title: Lähihoitaja, Pispan kotihoito
description:
Pispan kotihoidon moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä. Pitkät hoitosuhteet ovat arvokkaitta sekä asiakkaille että hoitajille.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto).
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta sekä RAI-osaamisen.
Sinulla on hyvät työyhteisötaidot, toimit oma-aloitteisesti ja joustavasti.

Aloitus vakituisessa tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Koeaika on kuusi kuukautta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Jätä rohkeasti hakemuksesi ja liity Pispan rempseään ja huumorilla höystettyyn osaavaan tiimiin, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä! Haastatteluun kutsuttaviin hakijoihin olemme yhteydessä henkilökohtaisesti.

description:
_Tabox Services Oy on vuonna 2021 perustettu kunnossapitopalveluiden erikoisosaaja, joka tarjoaa kattavia huolto-, kunnossapito-, projekti- ja vikakorjauspalveluja erityisesti konepaja- ja prosessiteollisuuden tarpeisiin. Tavoitteemme on turvata asiakkaidemme tuotantolaitteiden korkea toimintavarmuus ja minimoida tuotantokatkokset ennakoivan kunnossapidon avulla. Meillä pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ympäristössä yli 80 huippuammattilaisen kanssa haastavissa ja monipuolisissa tehtävissä, jotka kehittävät osaamistasi jatkuvasti._

Toimintamme laajentuessa haemme nyt Lahteen asiakkaidemme kohteisiin

**SÄHKÖAUTOMAATIOASENTAJIA**

Sähköautomaatioasentajana huolehdit sekä ennakkohuolloista että vikakeikoista ja -korjauksista asiakkaan työstökoneympäristössä. Keskeisiä tehtäviäsi ovat lisäksi

- Kunnossapitojärjestelmän käyttö ja tietojen ajantasaisuuden varmistaminen

- Varaosien selvitys ja tilaaminen sekä varaosavaraston ylläpito

- Asiakaspalvelu ja aktiivinen kommunikointi asiakkaan kanssa

- Työympäristön turvallisuuden ja siisteyden varmistaminen, ml. tarvittavien riskikartoitusten teko

- Uusien järjestelmien käyttöönotossa avustaminen ja tukeminen


Tehtävässä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä niin asiakkaan koneoperaattoreiden, kunnossapidon ja kiinteistön asiantuntijoiden kuin myös toimittajien kanssa. Eikä pidä unohtaa Tabox Services:n työkavereita eri paikkakunnilla, eri projekteissa ja eri tehtävissä, jotka muodostavat sinulle tiiviin yhteistyöverkoston!

Uskomme, että tehtävässä onnistumista ja meillä viihtymistäsi tukevat

- Kokemus teollisuuden sähkö- ja automaatioasennuksista koskien työstökoneita ja työstökoneiden logiikoita

- Perusosaaminen mekaanisesta asennuksesta

- Ymmärrys teollisuuden toimintaympäristöstä

- Sähköautomaatioon, koneasennukseen ja/tai kunnossapitoon soveltuva koulutus

- Suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen ja englannin kielen taito

- Tietotekninen osaaminen ja erityisesti kokemus kunnossapito- ja toiminnanohjausjärjestelmistä

- Hyvät asiakaspalvelu-, kommunikointi- ja yhteistyötaidot

- Kyky itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja hyvä paineensietokyky

- Erinomaiset ongelmanratkaisutaidot

- Sitoutuminen työturvallisuuden varmistamiseen ja sen jatkuvaan kehittämiseen


Hienoa, jos sinulla on lisäksi kokemusta erityisesti teollisuuden kunnossapidosta ja/tai hitsauksesta, syvempää kokemusta Siemensin, Heidenhain tai Fanucin ohjauksista, sähkötyöturvakortti SFS 6002, sekä mahdollisesti myös kokemusta työnjohdollisista tai niitä avustavista tehtävistä.

Pidämme tehtävässä tärkeänä ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Huomioithan myös, että asiakkaamme edellyttävät huumausainetestausta.

Olemme kasvava ja kehittyvä yritys, jossa tuemme jokaisen kehittymistä erilaisilla kouluttautumisvaihtoehdoilla ja tarjoamalla myös mahdollisuuksia kansainvälisiin projekteihin ulkomailla. Työaikamme on joustava, toki asiakkaan tarpeet huomioiden, ja työarkeasi tukevat myös hyvät edut, kuten tuettu työpaikkalounas, laajennetut työterveyshuollon palvelut ja mahdollisuus liittyä sairauskassaan.

title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja (Pohjois-Pirkanmaa)
description:

Työtehtäväsi koostuvat kuorma-autojen katsastusremonteista, joissa vastaat mm. jarrujen ja ohjauslaitteiden tarkastamisesta, asentamisesta ja huoltamisesta. Työnkuva sisältää myös hitsaamista, joten MIG-hitsaustaitoa tarvitaan, ja mahdollinen puikkohitsaustaito koetaan eduksesi. Työaika on joustava arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin (40 h/vko), joten sinulla on mahdollista sovitella itse työaikasi viikkotuntien sisälle.

Toivomme sinulta:

\- kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksesta ja huollosta

\- kykyä etsiä ja ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia

\- osaamista hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta

\- kokemusta vianhausta sekä koneiden testauksesta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen vakaassa yrityksessä

\- monipuoliset ja teknisesti mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät

\- kattavan työterveyshuollon

\- osaamisesi huomioivan palkan, kerrothan rohkeasti palkkatoiveesi

\- tarvittavat työvarusteet ja -vaatteet

\- mukavan työyhteisön

\- Clickiltä asianmukaisen ja tunnetusti hyvän tuen koko työsuhteesi ajaksi

Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä? Jos kyllä, niin kuulisin sinusta mielelläni! Täytä hakemus pikimmiten oheisen linkin kautta. Kerro hakemuksessasi mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Jos sinulla tulee mitä vain kysyttävää työtehtävään liittyen, soita rohkeasti! title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

title: IT Admin / IT Support Specialist, ReOrbit, Helsinki
description:
ReOrbit is looking for a proactive and solutions-driven IT Administrator / IT Support Specialist to support our growing team and help keep our technology running smoothly across all locations.

As our IT Administrator, you will be the go-to person for ensuring a seamless IT experience for employees, both onsite and remotely. Youll play a key role in maintaining reliable systems, supporting modern workplace tools, and enabling the team to work efficiently and securely every day.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Core responsibilities:

- End-user IT support (Windows, Office 365, Google Workspace)

- Onboarding/offboarding — account creation, device provisioning, access management

- Active Directory / Entra ID and Group Policy administration

- Device management via Intune/MDM

- Hardware support: laptops, printers, mobiles, meeting room AV

- Ticket handling via Atlassian JIRA Service Management

- WiFi and network troubleshooting (LAN/WAN/VPN, connectivity issues)

- Application access management — provisioning, permissions and license assignment across M365, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Dynamics

- Shared mailbox access and licensing administration

- Documentation of processes, user help guides, and basic infrastructure setup notes

Skills and Requirements:

- 3 years in IT administration / end-user support

- Hands-on AD, Intune, and Microsoft 365 administration experience

- Comfortable being a hands-on, on-site presence with minimal supervision

- Fluent English (Finnish a plus, not required)

Application instructions and further information:

This is a six-month temporary agency employment, after which there is an opportunity to become directly employed by ReOrbit.

Register as an applicant and complete the application form carefully, and attach your CV to your application. In your application, please highlight how your strengths support the different aspects and focus areas of the role.

ReOrbit may require a security clearance for certain positions. Any such security clearance will be conducted in accordance with applicable law and the Company's relevant policies.


ReOrbit

What does ReOrbit do?

ReOrbit builds the foundation for the next generation of space applications by transforming satellites into truly intelligent, interconnected platforms, defined by software. Our satellite design philosophy revolves around the idea that satellites must network, communicate with each other and thus improve mission efficiency. How can this be achieved? Thanks to a flexible software-first architecture, where all these aspects are dealt with upfront in the mission concept, as integrated functionalities.

ReOrbits top-notch team of software engineers and system architects develop in-house software, procure hardware from the best-in-class suppliers, and seamlessly integrate the components to create flexible and secure satellites. Today, we are a rapidly growing company building a very strong multidisciplinary team to support our activities. We are headquartered in Helsinki, Finland with a subsidiaries in Bristol, UK, Bariloche, Argentina and Bengaluru, India.

Sähköposti: mia.viskari@staffpoint.fi

title: IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support, ReOrbit, Helsinki
description:
ReOrbit is looking for an IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support to build and scale the infrastructure, operating model and service foundations that enable the company to grow.

As our IT Lead – Infrastructure, Operations & Support, you will take ownership of how ReOrbits core IT infrastructure and operations are designed, managed and scaled. You will combine hands-on technical leadership with strong operational governance, building resilient and repeatable systems across infrastructure, cloud, end-user computing and support.

You will lead the Infrastructure, Operations & Support pillar of ReOrbits multi-year IT strategy, working closely with the Head of IT & Business Systems, Security, Engineering, Manufacturing and external partners. While end-user support will be owned and governed by this role, much of the day-to-day service delivery will be handled through the internal team and an outsourced 24/7 support partner.

It's an exciting chance to join a dynamic start-up, with the opportunity to make a real impact, to reach our goal of pushing the boundaries of space data transfer.

Responsibilities
- Own end-user support and the enterprise 24/7 service model, ensuring the Jira Service Desk operates against defined SLAs and KPIs.
- Lead and manage the outsourced support partner, holding external delivery accountable while retaining ownership of service quality internally.
- Establish and govern core IT operations processes, policies and standards across change, incident, problem and asset management, aligned with ITIL and ITSM principles.
- Define clear ownership models, runbooks and documentation to ensure operational delivery does not depend on individual knowledge.
- Define and govern SLAs, KPIs and operational metrics, producing regular dashboards, reporting and audits that provide clear visibility into service and infrastructure health.
- Manage IT asset inventory, procurement and vendor coordination across the organisation.
- Administer and support core end-user technology platforms, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Intune, MDM and Jamf.
- Lead and support the migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.

title: Project planner
description:
Nordec is a supplier of steel frame structures and façade solutions for construction projects across the Nordic region, with an established presence in Central and Eastern Europe, including Poland, Lithuania, the Czech Republic and Germany.

The company designs, fabricates and installs steel structures for buildings and bridges, covering the project lifecycle from engineering to installation. Projects range from industrial facilities, logistics buildings, data centres, commercial, public, sports and cultural buildings, and bridges. Nordec operates its own production units in Peräseinäjoki and Ylivieska in Finland, Oborniki in Poland and Gargždai in Lithuania.

For more information, visit www.nordec.com.

Our Multi-storey unit continues to grow, and we are now looking to strengthen our team with a

**_PROJECT PLANNER_**

**_Would you like to play a key role in ensuring that complex international projects progress according to plan?_**

As a Project Planner, you will be responsible for preparing, maintaining and monitoring overall project schedules. You will plan project activities and their dependencies, while coordinating schedules across engineering, procurement, production, logistics and installation. You will monitor project progress, anticipate potential delays and scheduling risks, and provide project management and customers with up-to-date information on project status. You will be involved in projects from the tendering phase through to execution, working closely with the Project Manager and the wider project organisation.

To succeed in this role, you have previous experience in project planning and scheduling, along with a good understanding of overall project schedules, activity dependencies, progress monitoring, forecasting and reporting. Experience in EPC/EPCM, industrial, construction, data centre, battery factory or other demanding large-scale projects provides a strong foundation for the role. You can take independent responsibility for project planning and scheduling.

The role requires experience with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, as well as a relevant technical degree, for example in civil, construction or mechanical engineering. Strong English skills are essential. You should also be able to communicate in Finnish with your team, while Swedish language skills are considered an advantage. For a candidate with extensive relevant experience, the position may be offered with the title Planning Manager.

An analytical, structured and systematic approach to work is important in this role, along with strong collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility as part of the wider project organisation.

The preferred location for the position is Seinäjoki or Vaasa, although other Nordec locations are also possible. The role offers flexible remote work. You should also be prepared to travel to factories and project sites, depending on project needs.

At Nordec, you will have the opportunity to work on large international projects in a role where your contribution has a direct impact on their success. You will be supported by an experienced project organisation and have the opportunity to develop both your own expertise and Nordecs project planning and scheduling processes.

The selected candidate will undergo a health examination and drug screening.

For more information about the position, please contact Mikaela Nyberg at WasaTalent, available Mondays to Thursdays, tel. 050 4141 600 or mikaela.nyberg@wasatalent.fi.

Please submit your application directly through WasaTalents recruitment system **no later than 5.10.2026.**

title: (Senior) Data Engineer (Snowflake) – Building and Technical Trade, K Group
description:
Snowflake is becoming the foundation of Building and Technical Trade's future data ecosystem. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you'll help define how data is modelled, built and utilized across analytics, AI and business development. Rather than joining a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to influence the development practices, data models and technical standards that will shape our future data platform. We are open to candidates from experienced Data Engineer to Senior Data Engineer level. The exact scope and level of responsibility can be shaped based on your background and expertise.

You will work as part of Kesko's Central Data & Analytics Platforms team while collaborating closely with Building and Technical Trade's Data, AI and ESG team. Together with BI analysts, analytics engineers, data experts and business stakeholders, you'll turn business needs into scalable and reliable data solutions that support both daily decision-making and future growth. We are working in a hybrid workplace model where we combine office days at K Kampus in Kalasatama and remote work to best suit both the role and the team. Come and join our professional team and start building your own kind of career in K Group!

What is the role about?

As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will be a key data expert helping BTT build a modern Snowflake-based data foundation for analytics, AI and business development. This is a hands-on senior role with strong architectural influence: you will help shape how Snowflake development is done in BTT, while working closely with the BTT Data, AI and ESG team and Keskos central data platform experts. In addition to building solutions, you will help grow the teams Snowflake capabilities through collaboration, mentoring and practical examples.

Your key responsibilities include:
- Technical ownership: owning the technical direction of BTTs Snowflake solutions and ensuring that solutions are reliable, maintainable and aligned with agreed platform principles - Best practices and architecture: defining BTTs Snowflake development practices, including modelling approach, warehouse strategy, documentation, quality and maintainability, while contributing to the broader data architecture and innovation - Mentoring and collaborating: coaching BTT data team members towards stronger Snowflake competence, collaborating with BI analysts, analytics engineers and business stakeholders, and translating business needs into practical data solutions - Building solutions: designing, building and optimizing scalable dbt-based data pipelines, transformations and logical and physical data models



Who are we looking for?

We are looking for an experienced data engineer who enjoys hands-on building but also thinks about the bigger picture, and who genuinely wants to help others grow.

We are not looking for unicorns, but the more of below capabilities are found the better youd fit to the ideal candidate profile:
- Snowflake, dbt and SQL: strong hands-on experience in data engineering with Snowflake, proficiency with dbt for transformations, efficient SQL skills and solid data modelling capability. (This one is actually mandatory) - Modern engineering practices: experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines and a DevOps mindset in a data context; what we develop, we also support. - Background in data warehousing/ETL: You have designed or maintained data pipelines with different technologies. Experience with SAP BW data models and transformations is beneficial, as it helps in understanding our legacy environment. - Data management mindset: Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage tools, semantic views, or overall data governance frameworks. You care about documentation and data quality. - Big picture view: the ability to make sound technical choices across source data, data modelling, transformations and reporting needs, not just build individual pipelines. - Mentoring ability: experience and motivation in sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to the development of data engineering practices - AI mindset: interest in leveraging AI to speed up and improve development and maintenance processes - Communication: excellent teamwork and communication skills, and the ability to explain complex data topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Fluency in English is required (our working language). Finnish or other Nordic language skills are beneficial but not necessary. - Self-driven and proactive attitude: You take initiative to improve things and arent afraid to suggest new ideas. You are solution-oriented and able to work independently when needed, but also know when to ask for help or input. - Relevant experience with SAP, Aspect4 or web-based business application data as well as familiarity with chain-operated wholesale and/or merchant-led retail business models, especially in the building and technical trade sector










Please note that the role is in Finland and you will need the existing right to work here. Kesko is unable to sponsor work permits or visas.

Why join us?

We offer you the chance to work in a key role, building a modern data platform in a large and diverse organization. Rather than stepping into a fully established environment, you'll have a rare opportunity to help define the development standards, modelling principles and engineering practices that will shape how BTT utilizes Keskos Snowflake platform.

With us you get:
- a genuinely impactful, hands-on role in building our Snowflake data platform from the ground up - a supportive community of expert colleagues in both BTT and Keskos central data teams - the opportunity to influence the technical direction, best practices and ways of working of our future data platform - modern work tools and numerous opportunities to learn, develop and grow your career in a large, international organization - extensive K Group employee benefits, including a mobile-phone benefit, culture, well-being and sports benefit (ePassi Flex), staff discounts in K Group stores, own occupational health care, leisure-time accident insurance, and a car benefit according to our company policy. - partner benefits related to optical stores, accommodation and travel, as well as sports and wellbeing services - a flexible hybrid working model with at least one office day per week

title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi?

8. Milloin voisit aloittaa?

9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä?


**Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com**

title: Senior Project Manager DSAR Process Transformation
description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager for our client in the media sector.

Role Description:
The client is currently looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and scoping of the automation of our GDPR Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) process. The current process is largely manual and involves multiple teams, systems and data owners. The objective of the assignment is to deliver an approved and actionable plan for future automation, including a documented current-state and gap analysis, aligned Privacy requirements, a governance model and a phased roadmap for technical implementation. The aim is to implement technical automation of the GDPR process starting from next year.

The DSAR process has an established process owner who owns the process and related business decisions. The Senior Project Manager will work closely with the process owner and coordinate the initiative across Privacy, Legal, Data, Technology and relevant business stakeholders. Team size of 15-20 people.

Responsibilities:
· Lead the planning, coordination and overall delivery of the DSAR automation planning project
· Define and maintain project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones and timelines
· Coordinate the mapping and documentation of the current DSAR process across relevant teams, systems and data sources
· Coordinate the identification of process, compliance, governance and technical gaps together with the process owner and subject-matter experts
· Identify and track open questions, risks, dependencies, blockers and required decisions
· Support the process owner and privacy stakeholders in aligning and documenting privacy requirements and required risk decisions
· Coordinate the definition of the future-state process, governance model, roles and responsibilities
· Coordinate technical stakeholders in identifying automation opportunities, integration needs and technical dependencies
· Ensure agreed business, process and privacy requirements are translated into a clear scope for future technical implementation
· Develop a prioritised and phased roadmap for the technical automation build together with technical stakeholders
· Prepare status reporting, recommendations and decision material for management

Expected Deliverables:
· Current-state process map and scope document
· Gap analysis (process, compliance, governance, technical)
· Documented Privacy requirements and risk decisions
· Governance model with defined roles and responsibilities (e.g. RACI)
· Prioritised, phased automation roadmap
· Approved plan with agreed next steps for implementation

Skills and Qualifications:
· Strong experience leading complex cross-functional transformation, regulatory or technology projects
· Strong project management skills
· Previous experience and knowledge of GDPR, privacy programmes, DSAR/DSR processes or other regulatory processes
· Experience with process or workflow automation
· Experience with enterprise data landscapes involving multiple systems and data owners
· Proven ability to structure ambiguous and fragmented problem areas into clear scope, decisions and deliverables
· Experience coordinating work across business and technical stakeholders
· Experience with current-state assessments, gap analyses and roadmap development
· Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills
· Experience managing project risks, dependencies and competing priorities
· Ability to prepare clear management-level recommendations and decision material

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
1. Have you led a GDPR, privacy, or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) transformation project from planning through implementation?
