title: Plant Manager - Marl (Werkleiter/in)
description:
Der Plant Manager ist für die Gesamtleitung von zwei Produktionsstandorten in Marl verantwortlich. Der Schwerpunkt der Position liegt auf Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, operativer Effizienz sowie der Koordination der Logistik.

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller geltenden EHS-Gesetze und -Vorschriften sowie der internen Group-Richtlinien an den Produktionsstandorten.
- Verantwortung für Produktionsleistung, Produktqualität, Durchsatz und termingerechte Lieferungen.
- Planung und Überwachung der operativen Budgets sowie Sicherstellung einer effektiven Kostenkontrolle.
- Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse unter Anwendung von Lean-Manufacturing-Prinzipien.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller lokalen und unternehmensinternen EHS-Anforderungen, einschließlich Gefährdungsbeurteilungen und arbeitsmedizinischer bzw. arbeitshygienischer Programme.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Anforderungen hinsichtlich des sicheren Betriebs und der Instandhaltung von Produktionsanlagen und Maschinen.
- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.
- Sicherstellung, dass die Produktionskosten innerhalb der genehmigten Budgets bleiben.
- Erstellung regelmäßiger Betriebs- und Leistungsberichte für den zuständigen Vorgesetzten, einschließlich: - Operative Leistungskennzahlen
- Qualität der Fertigprodukte in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung
- Wesentliche Produktions- und Kostenkennzahlen
- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Instandhaltung zur Minimierung von Stillstandszeiten und Maximierung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit.
- Führung, Entwicklung, Coaching und Motivation des Standortteams.
- Bearbeitung von Leistungs- und Verhaltensangelegenheiten bei Bedarf.
- Organisation und Überwachung der vierteljährlichen und jährlichen Bestandsaufnahmen.
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Abteilungen Logistik, Qualität, Instandhaltung, EHS, Finanzen und HR.
- Nationale und internationale Reisetätigkeit nach Bedarf (ca. 5 %).

Anforderungen:

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen, z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Bergbau oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in einem produzierenden, industriellen, bergbaulichen oder vergleichbaren Produktionsumfeld.
- Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich der Betriebs- und Produktionsabläufe, einschließlich Arbeitssicherheit, Produktion, Qualität, Prozesse, Instandhaltung und Investitionsprojekte (CapEx).
- Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams sowie im operativen Management.
- Ausgeprägte Führungs-, Entscheidungs- und Problemlösungskompetenz.
- Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen und schnelllebigen Umfeld zu steuern.
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit.
- Ausgeprägter Fokus auf Sicherheit, Qualität, operative Exzellenz und Kundenanforderungen.
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

As a global organisation operating across multiple countries, compensation for this role may vary depending on location, local market benchmarks, and experience.
In line with our commitment to pay transparency, a salary range relevant to your location will be shared with you during the early stages of the recruitment process, before any interview is scheduled.

title: Hero Support Specialist (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Specialist, Hero Support to join the People & Culture team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

- Your Role: As a Specialist in Hero Support, you will play a key role in managing HR operations, optimizing employee lifecycle workflows, and ensuring smooth service delivery across DHSE Central. You'll bring a blend of strong operational expertise and a continuous improvement mindset to keep our processes efficient, compliant, and candidate- and employee-friendly.
- Operations & Case Management: Act as a primary operational contact for employee and manager queries via Jira, Slack, and email, independently resolving mixed-complexity tickets per month while maintaining >90% SLA adherence.
- End-to-End Lifecycle Operations: Execute employee lifecycle processes including employment contracts, amendments, probation management, transfers, and terminations, supporting a wide range of teams across the organization.
- Data Integrity & Compensation Administration: Maintain accurate employee records in Workday and support pre-payroll data reconciliation, one-time payments, and compensation updates with 95% accuracy and strong attention to compliance.
- Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory: Apply working knowledge of German labor law and company policies to partner effectively with Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Legal, and People Partners, serving as a trusted consultative advisor to managers and stakeholders across the business.
- Process Improvement & Automation: Identify operational bottlenecks and drive workflow enhancements in Workday and Jira, implementing process improvements per quarter to continuously elevate the employee experience.
- Knowledge Management: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and self-service Knowledge Base resources for employees and managers.
- Projects & Operational Excellence: Support cross-functional initiatives across HR compliance, process digitization, and audit readiness to enhance scalability and service quality.

Qualifications

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.
- Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) and strong working knowledge of German (B1+ minimum).
- Experience in global mobility operations and business travel administration is considered a strong plus.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading

delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

title: Junior Key-Account-Manager - Vollzeit (m/w/d) (Key-Account-Manager/in)
description:
Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Key-Account-Management, die uns dabei unterstützen, den Kontakt zu unseren Kunden zu pflegen, unsere Projekte reibungslos zu organisieren und unser Ziel, die deutsche Industrie nachhaltig zu stärken, aktiv mitzugestalten.
Wenn du kommunikativ bist und gerne mit Kunden sprichst, ist diese Stelle genau das Richtige für dich. Du hältst den Kontakt zu unseren Bestandskunden, erfasst deren Wünsche und arbeitest eng mit unserem Online-Marketing-Team zusammen, um die Zufriedenheit unserer Bestandskunden sicherzustellen.

Aufgabengebiete (alle nach ausführlicher Einarbeitung):
Pflege und Ausbau der Kundenbeziehung zu unseren Agenturkunden (renommierte mittelständische Unternehmen)
Erfassung von Kundenwünschen sowie Vorstellung und Ausarbeitung neuer Marketingstrategien
Regelmäßige Feedback-Meetings mit unseren Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit führen
Verantwortung und Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit von unseren Agenturkunden
Inhaltliche Fragen von Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit und zu Werbekampagnen beantworten (telefonisch und schriftlich)
E-Mail-Support für eingehende Anfragen von Bestandskunden leisten
Sicherstellung und Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit

Über Uns
Schulze Marketing ist eine Agentur, die mit vollem Einsatz daran arbeitet, die deutsche Industrie zu stärken und weiterzuentwickeln. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Auftrags- und Mitarbeitergewinnung durch Online-Marketing sowie bei der Digitalisierung der betriebsinternen Prozesse.

Quereinsteiger sind herzlich willkommen!
Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2-4 Wochen.
Gehalt: Junior Key-Account-Manager/in (m/w/d): 4.000 € brutto im Monat.

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden.
Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Schulze Marketing haben möchtest, findest du diese auf karriere.schulzemarketing.de.

Deine Vorteile bei uns
Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.
Ausführliche interne Schulung: Durch unser internes Schulungssystem lernst du alles, was du für deine neue Tätigkeit bei uns im Unternehmen benötigst.
Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen.
Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig.
Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.
Ein dynamisches Team in einem motivierenden Arbeitsumfeld.
Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.

Stellenanforderungen
Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium (keine Berufserfahrung notwendig)
Analytisch-methodisches und strukturiertes Denken, Organisationsfähigkeit, Ergebnis- und Lösungsorientierung sowie ausgeprägte Teamorientierung gepaart mit sicherem Auftreten, einer selbstständigen Arbeitsweise und einem hohen Maß an Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Kundenbetreuung, Kundenkommunikation oder Customer Success von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich
Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen und diese aktiv weiterzuentwickeln
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Präzision
Saubere und fehlerfreie schriftliche Ausdrucksform in Deutsch
Guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

title: Technical Documentation Writer - Defense Technology - Permanent (H/F)
description:

TECHNICAL DOCUMENTATION WRITER - DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY (F/M)

Contract type Permanent position (Full-time)

Location Erding / Greater Munich Area, Germany (Hybrid)

Reference 2387

Contact

COMPANY PRESENTATION

Our client is an innovative defense technology company developing next-generation solutions that combine advanced sensors, secure communications, and intelligent data processing. Their systems support military and law enforcement operators by providing reliable situational awareness in demanding operational environments.

KEY POINTS OF THE POSITION

* Own the complete technical documentation landscape across multiple projects
* Work closely with engineering, quality, and production teams
* Play a key role in a highly regulated and mission-critical environment
* Drive documentation quality, consistency, and compliance from development through delivery

RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Technical Writer, your responsibilities will include:

* Create and maintain technical datasheets for products, subsystems, and components
* Write user manuals, installation guides, maintenance procedures, and technical documentation
* Ensure documentation remains accurate, structured, version-controlled, and aligned with product evolution
* Gather, review, and organize supplier certificates, test reports, and quality documentation
* Prepare complete documentation packages for customer deliveries, audits, and compliance requirements
* Develop training materials and documentation for internal teams and customers
* Collaborate with engineers to collect, understand, and validate technical information
* Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies, and risks before they impact projects
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of documentation processes and standards

NECESSARY SKILLS

* Proven experience as a Technical Writer in an industrial or engineering environment
* Strong ability to translate complex technical information into clear and structured documentation
* Experience working with technical specifications, engineering drawings, test reports, and product data
* Familiarity with documentation management, version control, and review processes
* Knowledge of quality standards and regulated environments (ISO 9001 or similar) is highly desirable
* Experience with Jira, Git, or similar documentation/version control tools is a plus
* Background in defense, aerospace, railway, medical devices, electronics, or other critical industries is advantageous
* Flawless German is mandatory
* Professional fluency in English
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently
* Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2/Ü2) is required

SALARY

€65,000 - €80,000 gross annual salary, depending on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit.

title: INŽENJER/INŽENJERKA STROJARSTVA
description:
Opis poslova:
  • provedba i nadzor QA/QC planova: izrada, implementacija i praćenje planova kontrole kvalitete (Quality Assurance / Quality Control) u skladu s tehničkom dokumentacijom i važećim normama.
  • kontrola kvalitete i inspekcija: provođenje vizualnih, dimenzionalnih i funkcionalnih inspekcija strojarskih sklopova, zavarenih spojeva, cjevovoda i opreme.

  • suradnja i koordinacija: komunikacija s klijentima, nadzornim inženjerima, proizvodnjom i vanjskim institucijama (inspekcijskim tijelima). Poslodavac na terenu osigurava smještaj i prijevoz. Radnici se u inozemstvu zapošljavaju kao izaslani radnici.

* Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen "Allrounder", die ihr Fachwissen und Können pragmatisch anwenden wollen und Lust auf Karriere haben
* Umsatz und Effizienz ist für uns nicht alles. Wir sind ein Team, daher sollten Sie sich auch bei der Ausbildung der Azubis oder für organisatorische Fragestellungen engagieren wollen

Wir suchen
* Steuerleute mit Qualifikation. Wie alt Sie sind, ist für uns unerheblich. Wir geben Berufseinsteigern genauso eine Chance wie "alten Hasen".
* in Voll- oder Teilzeit (mindestens drei halbe Tage). Die Möglichkeit zu Homeoffice besteht grundsätzlich, allerdings schätzen wir das tägliche Miteinander in der Kanzlei mehr und wollen Sie so bestmöglich in unser Team integrieren
* Auch Quer- oder Wiedereinsteiger sind bei uns willkommen! Wir legen großen Wert auf Aus- und Weiterbildung, daher unterstützen wir Sie gerne beim (Wieder-) Einstieg
* Mitarbeiter mit Engagement, fachlichen Ehrgeiz und Mandantenorientierung
* Mitarbeiter, die in einer inhabergeführten, kleinen Kanzlei kurze Entscheidungswege und offene Türen schätzen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen und die gerne im Team arbeiten und denken
* Kollegen/-innen mit Berufserfahrung, sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und Datev (z.B. Unternehmen Online, elektronisches Bankbuchen, ...)
* Eigenverantwortung, Qualitätsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit, ausgeprägte Dienstleistungsorientierung und Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, Kollegialität und Teamfähigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab

title: Electrical Construction Manager
description:
Electrical Construction Manager (Bauleiter Elektrotechnik)

Work tasks: Management of electrical installation teams and allocation of tasks.
Planning of works and monitoring of deadlines and the quality of work performed. Monitoring compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, technical requirements and quality standards. Ensuring that works are carried out in accordance with project documentation and technical requirements. Communication and coordination with the client, project management, other contractors and the company's management. Monitoring working hours and completed work volumes. Preparation and management of the required work documentation, reports and protocols. Coordination of the supply of required materials, tools and equipment to construction sites. Timely reporting to the company's management on work progress, deviations from the schedule and any issues arising on construction sites.

We offer: We offer long-term and stable employment in Germany, in the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia (Düsseldorf, Cologne and surrounding areas).
Gross salary of €3,800–€4,500 per month, depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications. The final salary will be agreed individually. Start as soon as possible. The employer provides accommodation in Germany and transportation required for work. The company covers flight tickets to Germany or other agreed travel expenses related to starting work. Official employment with an Estonian company, including the preparation of the necessary documents for working in Germany in accordance with applicable requirements. Work on long-term electrical installation projects. Working hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30–18:00.

- Deep familiarity with BMW development processes (e.g., PRISMA, ALM, or specific BMW diagnostic/flash protocols)
- Strong understanding of Embedded Linux, Android Automotive (AAOS), or QNX, knowledge of Adaptive AUTOSAR is a plus
- Fluency in German and English is mandatory for stakeholder management
- Strong negotiation skills for managing sub-suppliers and the ability to thrive under the pressure of SOP deadline

You can expect ...

- Experience in exciting and international projects
- Continuous salary development

- Appreciation, motivation and commitment

description:
INSBI gGmbH / Institut für soziale und berufliche Integration gGmbH

Wir suchen:
Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, Diplom/BA-Pädagoge/in, Erzieher/in (m/w/d)

Zu uns:
Die INSBI bietet betreutes Wohnen für unbegleitete minderjährige Flüchtlinge (UmF) ab 16 Jahren und für junge Volljährige an. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen einen sicheren und stabilen Lebensraum zu bieten, in dem sie Vertrauen, Orientierung und Perspektiven für ihre Zukunft entwickeln können.

In Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern und Bildungsträgern setzen wir uns für die gesellschaftliche und berufliche Integration junger Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf einem ressourcenorientierten Ansatz und folgt dem Prinzip des Empowerments: Wir begleiten die Jugendlichen individuell und stärken sie in ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Besonders für junge Flüchtlinge, die oft traumatische Erlebnisse hinter sich haben, ist eine stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehung essenziell. Durch unser Bezugsbetreuersystem bieten wir Halt, Orientierung und fördern ihre Selbstständigkeit.

Mit unserer langjährigen Erfahrung in der Jugendhilfe und Flüchtlingshilfe gestalten wir ein Umfeld, das Sicherheit, Schutz und eine realistische Zukunftsperspektive ermöglicht. Dabei legen wir Wert auf interkulturelle Sensibilität, Reflexion und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Akteuren, um den Jugendlichen bestmögliche Chancen zu bieten.

Darum geht's - Ihre Aufgaben
Als pädagogische/r Mitarbeiter/in in der ambulanten Betreuung im Betreuten Wohnen für minderjährige und junge volljährige Flüchtlinge übernehmen Sie unter anderem folgende Aufgaben:

- Anleitung und Unterstützung der jungen Menschen im lebenspraktischen Bereich, im Besonderen der Verselbstständigung in einer eigenen Wohnung oder WG.
- Begleitung und Unterstützung bei der Abklärung asyl- und aufenthaltsrechtlicher Fragen und der Sicherstellung des Lebensunterhalts
- Einzelförderung im schulischen, beruflichen, sozial-emotionalen und gesundheitlichen Bereich sowie Freizeitgestaltung
- Krisenintervention
- Zusammenarbeit mit Jugendämtern, Behörden, Rechtsanwältinnen, Schulen, Ausbilderinnen und Ärzt*innen
- Verwaltungstätigkeiten wie Dokumentation und Aktenführung
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen, Teamsupervision und Weiterbildungen.

Das bringen Sie mit - Ihr Profil

- Sie verfügen über eine Ausbildung/ein Studium zum/zur Sozialpädagoge/in oder Sozialarbeiter/in, Diplom/BA Pädagoge/in oder Erzieher/in oder sind Werksstudent/in und haben Freude an der Begleitung junger Menschen.
- Erfahrung in der pädagogischen Arbeit.
- Fähigkeit zur professionellen Beziehungsarbeit und die Bereitschaft zur kultursensiblen Arbeit.
- Kreativität, Flexibilität und Kooperationsfähigkeit.
- Freude an eigenständiger Arbeitsweise.

Unser Angebot - Ihre Vorteile

- Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich an der Berufsausbildung und der beruflichen Vorerfahrung orientiert.
- Attraktives Gleitzeitangebot.
- Fortlaufende Fachberatung und Supervision sowie Weiterbildungen.
- Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kollegen.
- Ein engagiertes Team.
- Familienfreundliches Arbeitsumfeld.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites

- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

description:

Dann übernehmen Sie den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebietes in Ungarn. Sie gewinnen neue Kunden, entwickeln bestehende Geschäftsbeziehungen weiter und beraten Unternehmen zu unseren Dienstleistungen und Produkten. - … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

Ihre Qualifikationen - ÜBERZEUGEND:

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.

title: QA On The Floor Specialist
description:

Join Alvotech’s Quality Assurance team and play a key role in supporting manufacturing operations while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements and quality standards. This hands-on position provides real-time QA support to manufacturing teams and contributes to the delivery of high-quality biopharmaceutical products.

- Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing environment.
- Strong knowledge of GMP, quality systems, documentation practices, GDP, and ALCOA principles.
- Experience supporting manufacturing operations and quality oversight activities.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
- Ability to work rotational shifts in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
- Proficient in written and spoken English.

- An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.
- The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.

title: QC Bioassay Principal Scientist
description:
We are searching for a motivated and detail oriented QC Bioassay Principal Scientist to support quality control testing activities for biosimilars. This role is responsible for executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assay, ensuring compliance with regulatory and GMP standards, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the QC laboratory.



Key Responsibility:

Independently accountable for completing assigned tasks and deliverables, while receiving direction and assignments from a supervisor.

Demonstrates in-depth knowledge and proficiency in Bioassay (cell-based potency assays, ELISA, binding assays etc).

Executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assays. Provide good technical input for Invalid assays investigations.

Executes non‑routine activities, including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and related investigation actions.

Prepare testing protocols and reports, and review laboratory and cell bank documentation.

Analyze, interpret, and document experimental data in line with ALCOA+ data integrity standards.

Support qualification and optimization of critical reagents (e.g., reference materials) and technical troubleshooting

Challenges and decisions are addressed collaboratively with cross‑functional teams, with solutions developed in partnership with the supervisor and other team members.

Possesses expert knowledge of cell‑based assays, including relevant methods, techniques and associated procedural and process requirements.

Provide technical training and support to team members and ensure proper understanding of laboratory methods and procedural requirements as needed.

Support technology transfer and validation activities by contributing to the preparation and review of technical documents.

Personally, authors and reviews key analytical sections related to potency methods within regulatory submissions, as well as responses to queries from health authorities and external partners.

Requires familiarity with ALCOA+ principles to uphold data integrity in regulated environments, ensuring records are accurate, traceable, and audit ready.



Qualifications and experience:

Master’s degree or Ph.D in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or a related field.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

title: Pig Farm Assistants
description:

Tulleka Trading ULC is seeking to employ Pig Farm Assistants for its pig production sites at Moate farm, Ballinakill Co Laois. The role involves the full lifecycle of pig husbandry, from breeding through to finishing, with a particular focus on proven, hands-on experience in managing the finishing stages. Key Duties and Responsibilities Manage finisher accommodation, monitor daily growth rates, grade finisher pigs by weight, and optimise feed conversion efficiency. Support breeding, farrowing, and weaning operations as required across the wider unit. Operate, monitor, and adjust automated or manual feeding and watering systems in accordance with precise farm production schedules. Ability to work as part of a team and follow farm production and biosecurity procedures. Good animal husbandry skills and attention to detail. Remuneration €36,605 per annum, based on a standard 39-hour working week. description:

Company Profile & Job Overview: Elecnor Ireland Limited is currently seeking an experienced Wireman to join our project teams based in County Kerry and County Sligo. We are a leading provider of engineering and energy infrastructure, specializing in high-voltage substations and power distribution networks across Ireland. In this role, you will be responsible for executing essential electrical installation work for major infrastructure projects, ensuring high standards of technical precision and quality. Key Responsibilities: - Installation of comprehensive cable management systems, including cable trays, ladder racks, and protective trunking. - Pulling, routing, and securing heavy industrial power cables, auxiliary cabling, and control cables across substation sites. - Precise termination and glanding of Steel Wire Armoured (SWA) cables, flexible control cabling, and multi-core signal wiring. - Wiring, dressing, and organizing complex control panels, protection relays, marshalling kiosks, and local control cubicles. - Working directly from detailed electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring schedules, and technical termination drawings. - Conducting pre-commissioning checks, continuity testing, and verifying connections alongside site engineering teams. - Ensuring all installation work complies strictly with project specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements. Key Requirements: - Solid experience as a Wireman or Industrial Electrician, ideally in High Voltage (HV) substations or industrial energy facilities. - Strong practical skills in heavy cable pulling, SWA glanding, cable management installation, and control panel wiring. - Ability to read and interpret complex electrical wiring diagrams, schematics, and schedules accurately. - High standard of workmanship, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively within a site team. Working Hours & Compensation: - Hours: Standard working week of 45 hours, Monday to Friday. - Salary: €40,000 to €45,000 per annum, depending on experience. - Benefits: 22 days of annual leave plus 10 public holidays, company-provided accommodation, and statutory pension contributions.

title: Care Assistant
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Care Assistant plays a key role in supporting adults with intellectual disabilities to live meaningful, fulfilling lives within a warm and inclusive home environment. Working as part of the house team, the Care Assistant provides person-centred support, contributes to the daily life of the house, and fosters positive relationships with Core Members, colleagues, and volunteers. The role involves practical care, emotional support, participation in community life, and collaboration with the House/Team Leader and wider team to ensure high-quality support in line with L’Arche values. Reporting to: House leader / Team Leader / Deputy Team Leader In Relation to the Core Members Build respectful, trusting, and supportive relationships with each Core Member. Support Core Members in their daily living activities (personal care, meals, household tasks, etc.) while promoting independence. Encourage and support Core Members to make choices and take responsibility in their own lives. Uphold the dignity, self-esteem, and individuality of each person. Follow care plans and Person-Centred Plans (PCPs) in line with HIQA standards. Support Core Members in communication, ensuring their voice is heard and respected. Assist with social, recreational, and community activities in line with Core Members’ interests. Support Core Members to attend appointments (medical, social, etc.) as required. Assist in maintaining accurate and confidential records. Support safe medication practices as directed and trained. Promote a safe, clean, and healthy living environment. In Relation to the Staff Team Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture. Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house. Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice. Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates. Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines. Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment. Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team. Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house. Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members. Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house. Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks. Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment. Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings. Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community. Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

title: Logistics Controller
Financial Operations Specialist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Unit 9, Block D Nutgrove Office Park, Rathfarnham, Dublin, Leinster, Ireland D14 Y382 Roly type: Full-time, permanent – 37.5 hours per week Salary - €36,605 per annum The Financial Operations Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and continuous improvement of finance operations across billing, revenue management, cash collections and reporting. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll help maintain financial integrity, improve processes and provide insights that support business performance. Key Responsibilities: Financial Analysis & Reporting Reconcile high-volume transactional data to ensure billing accuracy and revenue integrity. Produce regular financial and performance reports, including volume and margin analysis. Monitor billing activity, investigate discrepancies and implement corrective actions. Analyse financial data to identify trends, risks and opportunities. Support month-end and year-end reporting and reconciliation activities. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and performance metrics. Process Improvement & Systems Identify opportunities to streamline processes, increase automation and improve efficiency. Support finance system enhancements and business improvement projects. Review existing workflows and implement solutions that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort. Maintain process documentation and support internal and external audits. Business Partnering Provide data-driven insights to support business planning and decision-making. Financial Operations Support business-critical Direct Debit collections, managing substantial weekly cash flows. Oversee billing, revenue tracking, financial administration and reporting activities. Ensure timely invoicing and accurate revenue recognition. Maintain the accuracy and consistency of financial data across systems. Skills & Experience Experience in finance operations, financial analysis, billing or revenue management. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience producing financial reports, reconciliations and performance analysis. Strong problem-solving and process improvement capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience with financial systems and reporting tools. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys combining data analysis, operational ownership and continuous improvement to help drive business success.

title: School Aged Childcare Deputy Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Role: School Aged Childcare Deputy Manager Reporting to: Centre Manager & Company Directors Essential Qualifications: QQI Level 7/8 Early Years Graduate (or equivalent) & 3+ years in a lead practitioner role Hours: 45 hours per week Rate of Pay: €18.50 per hour OVERALL DUTIES Report directly to the Manager and act as Designated Person in Charge in their absence. Assist in staff recruitment, management, training, motivation, and performance monitoring. Ensure delivery of a dynamic emergent curriculum meeting individual children's needs. Maintain quality and safety standards across all operations at all times. Monitor child protection, complaints, incidents, and near-misses; take prompt remedial action and report child protection concerns to Tusla using Children First Guidelines. Maintain professional relationships with external agencies (TUSLA, Dept of Education, Pobal, EHO, Early Intervention Team). Serve as Designated First Aid, Fire Safety, and Deputy Child Protection Person. Facilitate inspections and ensure all required information is provided. Oversee daily service closing at 6:30pm. CHILDREN Provide room relief coverage during staff absences. Ensure all care and educational delivery is child-centred and aligned with Síolta and Aistear frameworks. Oversee developmental observations, Aistear assessments, and individual care/learning plans, including for children with additional needs. Promote equality, diversity, and inclusion within curriculum delivery. Ensure compliance with the Child Care Act 1991 (Early Years Services Regulations 2016 / School Age Services Regulations 2018) and relevant standards. STAFF Provide direction, leadership, and support to childcare practitioners and students. Maintain statutory staff:child ratios and monitor daily staffing levels, rotas, and breaks. Conduct regular staff review meetings and address performance issues in line with company policy. MANAGEMENT / ADMINISTRATION Maintain required administrative records, incident/accident logs, fee records, and visitor logs. Ensure all centre policies and procedures (childcare, employment, health & safety) are implemented and reviewed regularly. HEALTH AND SAFETY Ensure health, safety, and well-being of all children and report potential risks or hazards promptly. PARENTS / GUARDIANS Maintain professional communication and constructive feedback with parents/guardians. Organize and host welcome evening sessions for parents and follow up on queries. TRAINING AND MEETINGS Attend and encourage staff participation in required meetings and training (e.g., First Aid, Manual Handling). FLEXIBILITY Maintain flexibility and complete self-directed professional development as needed. COMMUNICATION Communicate clearly and professionally with internal personnel and external stakeholders/agencies. CONFIDENTIALITY The person appointed to this job shall not during the period of employment maintain professional confidentiality.

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per azienda cliente leader nel settore impermeabilizzazione di strutture selezioniamo: TECNICO COMMERCIALE AREA EMILIA_AMBITO CIVILE/EDILE Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nella rete commerciale e lavorando a stretto contatto con Area Manager e agenti di zona, sarai un punto di riferimento tecnico per progettisti, imprese e installatori, con un ruolo dinamico tra ufficio e cantiere. In particolare, sarai specialista nel fornire soluzioni tecnico-commerciali presso clientela B2B (studi di progettazione, imprese, installatori e distributori): - supporterai il team commerciale nella definizione della proposta tecnica e tramite sopralluoghi operativi in cantiere - gestirai incontri tecnici e formativi rivolti a progettisti e installatori per diffondere competenze applicative e qualità esecutiva - implementerai nuove relazioni sul territorio e contribuirai all'inserimento delle soluzioni nei capitolati Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - formazione in ambito edile/civile (Ingegneria Edile/Civile, Architettura/Geometra) - esperienza in ruoli tecnico-commerciali nel settore edile (o contesti affini) - dimestichezza con AutoCAD e Office 365 - conoscenza della lingua inglese intermedia - ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, orientamento agli obiettivi e curiosità professionale - disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio (ruolo in mobilità nell'area Emilia Romagna) Orario di lavoro: full time, dal lunedì al venerdì (attività prevalentemente sul territorio con flessibilità operativa e possibilità di smart working). Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato per figure middle/senior nel ruolo, mentre con risorse entry level è previsto un apprendistato professionalizzante finalizzato all'indeterminato CCNL applicato: Industria calce, cemento e gesso La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 36.000 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alle mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. Sono inoltre previsti auto ad uso promiscuo, PC e telefono aziendale, incentivi legati ai risultati. Prevista formazione iniziale con training 1-2 settimane presso l'HQ in provincia di Treviso. Luogo di lavoro: Emilia-Romagna (ruolo in mobilità: smart working + presidio presso Clienti e cantieri nell'area) - base preferibile Bologna Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Engineering è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: Sei un giovane Diplomato a cui piacerebbe lavorare in un contesto dinamico e attento alla formazione delle risorse? Questa è l'opportunità giusta per TE! Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico, in partnership con Rotolito SpA, storica azienda italiana che opera nel settore della carta stampata e leader nelle arti grafiche, cerca persone motivate a iniziare un nuovo percorso formativo-lavorativo (IFTS) progettato in collaborazione con l'Istituto Formazione Operatori Aziendali (IFOA) da inserire come ADDETTA/O MANUTENZIONE MACCHINE STAMPA Il ruolo ha lo scopo di prevenire e riparare i guasti dei macchinari tipografici o industriali. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Sarai assunto/a con un Contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello, che ti permetterà di acquisire competenze orientate all'innovazione tecnologica in ambito: - Tecnologie dei processi di produzione (Processi grafici, materie prime, macchine, attrezzature); - Controllo qualità del prodotto; - Certificazioni di processo; - Logistica industriale; che verranno certificate attraverso il rilascio di un titolo di studio (Certificato di Specializzazione Tecnica Superiore) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano ed europeo. Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. CCNL applicato: Grafica Industria Livello di inquadramento: D1 (€1.703, 76 lordi mensili) Retribuzione: Formazione Esterna (300 ore): Non Retribuita Formazione Interna (500 ore): 50% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 4,91 lordi orari) Ore Lavoro (Ca. 200 ore): 70% rispetto al Livello di inserimento previsto (€ 6,88 lordi orari) Luogo di lavoro: Cernusco sul Naviglio (MI) Se sei interessato/a a partecipare a questo percorso presenta la tua candidatura e, in presenza dei requisiti richiesti, sarai ricontattato da un nostro consulente. Cosa aspetti? Non perdere l'opportunità di partecipare al percorso e iniziare a fare la differenza nel settore della grafica! title: consulente di ricerca e selezione del personale
description: Gi Group SpA, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro Italiana ricerca per la propria divisione Gi EDU: FORMATORE / FORMATRICE SENIOR IL RUOLO Il/la professionista si occuperà della formazione dedicata ai DOCENTI di un istituto superiore di secondo grado, avrà la responsabilità di progettare e realizzare il percorso formativo, traducendo gli obiettivi didattici in contenuti, strumenti e attività immediatamente spendibili nella pratica scolastica. Svolgerà le seguenti attività: - Progettazione del percorso formativo in coerenza con gli obiettivi e i bisogni della scuola; - predisposizione dei materiali didattici e delle esercitazioni; - erogazione della formazione in presenza e/o da remoto, secondo il cronoprogramma concordato; - gestione di attività laboratoriali, casi e momenti di confronto con i docenti; - collaborazione al monitoraggio in itinere dell'andamento e degli esiti della formazione. Cerchiamo un/una professionista capace di coniugare competenza specialistica, concretezza e capacità di coinvolgere i docenti, trasformando la formazione in strumenti realmente applicabili in classe. REQUISITI RICHIESTI: - percorso di studi coerente con le tematiche della formazione; preferibile Laurea in Psicologia, Pedagogia o Sociologia; - conoscenza approfondita di BES, DSA e didattica inclusiva; - esperienza nella formazione di gruppi di adulti; costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza nel mondo della scuola e nella formazione del personale docente; - capacità di progettare materiali, esercitazioni e strumenti operativi per i docenti; - ottime capacità relazionali, comunicative ed empatiche, organizzazione e attitudine al lavoro in team. CONDIZIONI DELLA COLLABORAZIONE Tipologia contrattuale: collaborazione con PARTITA IVA Compenso: 40,00 € all'ora, IVA inclusa Orario: nella fascia oraria pomeridiana, orario da definire in accordo con la disponibilità della risorsa e le esigenze della scuola. Il progetto sarà erogato in 60 ore circa da pianificare in due macro moduli. SEDE Luogo di lavoro: Anagni (FR). title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Lavorerai con Python (anche in ottica OOP) e con strumenti come Pandas e NumPy per preparare, pulire e valorizzare i dataset, fino a realizzare analisi e visualizzazioni efficaci e dashboard. description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni.
