title: Marketing & Communication Manager / SEB, Luxembourg (m/f)
employer: SKANDINAVISKA ENSKILDA BANKEN AB Luxembourg Branch S.A.E.
description:
Marketing & Communication Manager | SEB, Luxembourg

SEB is a leading international financial services group with a strong and well-established client base among both corporate and financial institutions. We consistently earn recognition for our expertise and customer centric approach, achievements made possible by truly listening to our clients, committing to quality and trust, and fostering an entrepreneurial mindset throughout the organization.  

SEB Luxembourg branch serves as the hub for Private Wealth Management & Family Office (PWM&FO) services to Nordic nationals living abroad. As part of the new strategy for PWM&FO we aim to become the leading wealth accumulator in our core markets and that requires a state-of-the-art core banking offering and financial infrastructure. It is also the base for many of SEB's funds and offers global custody and related depositary services to financial institutions.

SEB in Luxembourg has supported our home market clients with their international needs since 1973. Today the Branch has approximately 170 employees of over 25 different nationalities.

About the role

You will be part of a team, executing on an ambitious growth and transformation agenda. We foster an inclusive leadership culture built on empowerment and involvement to creating an environment where innovation can thrive.  
As the Marketing & Communication Manager for SEB AB Luxembourg Branch, your responsibilities stretch across borders, including PWM&FO in Luxembourg, Singapore, Norway, Finland and the United Kingdom, as well as our support offices in Nice and Switzerland. You will act as a strategic partner to the business, supporting growth and development by aligning marketing and communication activities with business objectives.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Overall responsibility for the coordination and implementation of the SEB Group Marketing and Communications approach in relation to corporate branding, visual and written identity. Daily tasks include maintenance and development of templates, internal awareness-raising and education activities, and providing advice on sponsoring and other branding matters.
• Maintaining close collaboration with the SEB Group Marketing and Communications department, other relevant stakeholders across the business division, and external parties.
• Responsible for production, distribution and record-keeping of marketing materials, including product sheets, sales material, newsletters, brochures, advertisements and event invitations, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with cross-border policies and standards.  
• Support the planning and coordination of events in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, including the creation and distribution of invitations and follow-up activities.
• Responsible for external and internal communications, including production, distribution and record-keeping of client letters, newsletters, reports, statements, social media content and press materials. Support the bank`s employer branding, employee engagement and networking activities.
• Own & manage the banks of web and digital channels, including  creation, publication, and maintenance of content in internal and external platforms.
• Support the development of marketing and communication initiatives that strengthen the SEB brand and support business priorities.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

We believe you will bring a combination of marketing and communication expertise, strong project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, taking ownership of your responsibilities while maintaining a structured approach to delivering high-quality results.
You demonstrate integrity and professionalism in handling sensitive information, communicate effectively with wide range of stakeholders and can combine practical problem-solving skills with analytical thinking.

In addition, you have:

• At least 3 years of working experience, with proven track record of working with Marketing and / or Communication.
• A bachelor's or master's degree within Marketing or another relevant field
• Experience planning and coordinating marketing and communication initiative across multiple channels
• Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite tools such as InDesign, Photoshop and Illustrator, combined with strong Microsoft Office skills
• Fluency in written and spoken English and Swedish, or other Scandinavian languages
• Knowledge of any of the three official languages in Luxembourg (French, German, Luxembourgish) is considered a strong advantage in dealing with local stakeholders, press and other external stakeholders.

What we offer

We offer many experiences and benefits to our employees, and there is nuance to every individual's career experience, but the elements that define the core of our offering are:

• Innovative company at the forefront of technology international opportunities and working environment
• Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits 
• A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
• Possibility to work from home part of the working time
• A diverse, inclusive and equal environment with focus on health & wellbeing

It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.  
Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts:
https://sebgroup.com/career & https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

Ready to join?

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application with your CV and Cover Letter in English as soon as possible, but at the latest on 13 October 2026.

Please be informed that candidate selected for this role will need to provide their Criminal Record Certificate and a name screening against sanctions list will be performed as a part of the background check process.

description:
Securities Lending Product Manager (f/m/d)

Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group

Your area of work

As a Senior Securities Lending Product Manager, you will play a leading role in shaping, developing, and commercializing Clearstream's securities lending and borrowing proposition within the broader Collateral, Lending & Liquidity Solutions (CLLS) franchise. The role combines strategic product leadership with practical product ownership across securities lending and borrowing, aligned with collateral management and liquidity, settlement efficiency, regulation, risk, digital transformation, and commercial growth.

You will drive the evolution of securities lending solutions for various clients' segments, ensuring the proposition remains competitive, scalable, risk-aware, operationally robust, and aligned with client demand, market structure, regulatory expectations, and digital capabilities. You will work closely with Trading, Sales and Relationship Management, Client Service, Collateral Management and Liquidity Products, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to translate market opportunities into deliverable product outcomes and resilient day-to-day operating models.

Your responsibilities

• Define, support and execute the strategic roadmap for securities lending and borrowing solutions, aligning product development with client needs, market trends, regulatory change, operational resilience, and the wider CLLS growth strategy.
• Identify opportunities across securities lending, funding and financing, balance-sheet optimization, and settlement efficiency, translating overlapping needs into scalable product capabilities and commercial solutions.
• Lead end-to-end product initiatives from concept and business case through design, governance, implementation, launch, operational readiness, post-launch performance review, and continuous enhancement.
• Develop clear product positioning, value propositions, pricing approaches, commercial proposals, and go-to-market materials that support client adoption and differentiate Clearstream in the securities finance market.
• Act as a senior subject matter expert on securities lending market structure, lender and borrower dynamics, collateral flows, settlement efficiency, and regulatory developments including SFTR, CSDR, T+1, and evolving capital and liquidity requirements.
• Translate regulatory and market changes, into practical product, operational, legal, and control requirements. Coordinate the alignment across Product, Legal, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and client-facing teams.
• Drive digital transformation across the securities lending proposition, including data-led decision-making, automation, workflow optimization, digital client channels, analytics, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, KPIs, and platform scalability.
• Use market data, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, incident trends, and performance analytics to identify opportunities for revenue growth, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and improved client experience.
• Maintain strong awareness of risk, credit, collateral eligibility, control frameworks, and operational dependencies to ensure the robustness of the securities lending proposition
• Represent Clearstream at industry conferences, client events, market forums, trade associations, and working groups, contributing to thought leadership and strengthening the firm's market presence.
• Prepare and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Sales and Relationship management, Trading, Client Service, Operations, Technology, Legal, Risk, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Pricing to ensure successful product delivery, adoption, and operational sustainability.
• Mentor colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, commercially focused, risk-aware, and innovation-oriented product culture.

Your profile

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Financial Markets, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an advantage.
• 7+ years of experience in securities lending, securities finance, collateral management, market infrastructure, product management, or related capital markets activities.
• Good understanding of securities lending and borrowing, funding and financing market dynamics
• High awareness of the links between securities lending, collateral management, liquidity, funding, capital efficiency, risk, credit, control frameworks, and regulatory constraints in a financial market infrastructure environment.
• Proven track record of executing product strategy, building business cases, managing roadmaps, defining pricing approaches, and delivering complex cross-functional initiatives in regulated financial services.
• Ability to translate market and regulatory change into clear product impacts, operational requirements, legal documentation needs, control considerations, and implementation priorities.
• Commercial mindset with the ability to convert market intelligence, client feedback, trading insights, operational metrics, and industry developments into practical product enhancements and revenue opportunities.
• Strong digital and data orientation, with practical understanding of analytics, automation, workflow tools, dashboards, AI-enabled use cases, APIs, platform transformation, KPIs, and Agile delivery concepts.
• Experience engaging in industry forums, client events, working groups, conferences, or market associations,
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus across matrix teams, and drive clarity in complex, technical, or ambiguous situations.
• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills,
• Fluency in English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

About the LCSB
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. We excel because we are truly interdisciplinary, and together we contribute to science and society.

Your role
We seek a highly motivated software developer to join a FNR JUMP-funded project translating a validated suite of bioinformatics software tools into CausalOmics, an integrated software platform for causal analysis of omics data. The platform identifies root causal genes and candidate drug targets from multi-omics datasets.
The candidate will contribute to the further development of the unified, point-and-click user interface, implement interactive visualization frameworks for complex biological networks, and develop the core platform architecture that connects the analysis modules, spanning preprocessing, network and pathway analysis, causal reasoning, drug target assessment, and machine learning, through robust APIs.
Further responsibilities include setting up the cloud deployment infrastructure (SaaS architecture, REST API) and ensuring the platform is scalable, reproducible, and accessible to users without coding or bioinformatics expertise. The role is closely linked to the CausalOmics go-to-market project, and the candidate will work directly with the project's principal investigator and its interdisciplinary bioinformatics and business development team.
This position is offered with the explicit intent that the successful candidate may take on the role of Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Lead Developer of the planned CausalOmics spin-off company after incorporation.

Your profile
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field: MSc or equivalent; PhD an advantage
• Proven experience in full-stack web development, including front-end frameworks and back-end/API design
• Experience with interactive data visualization and building user-friendly, no-code interfaces for complex analytical workflows
• Familiarity with cloud deployment (SaaS architectures, REST APIs, CI/CD) is highly advantageous
• An interest in, or prior exposure to, bioinformatics or biomedical data is a plus but not required
• Strong software architecture and code quality skills, including experience with scalable, modular system design
• Cross-disciplinary aptitude, strong organizational and interpersonal skills, and interest in a translational, commercially oriented research environment
• Excellent command in English

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

Job Description

Senior Corporate Governance Officer

3.1 You are passionate about your field, understand the importance of corporate governance and are excited about delivering a great product. 3.4 You hold a Bachelor's degree (or higher/equivalent), have experience relevant to this role (minimum 3 years) and in supporting a variety of alternative and/or UCITS fund structures and like to keep up-to-date with the latest trends in governance practice. You either hold a related Company Secretarial / Corporate Governance qualification or would be keen to study one with our financial support. You have a great command of English and knowledge of other languages would be a plus.

4. What we offer

4.1 A chance to be a driving force behind a growing success story at a young and exciting firm with a culture focused on the successes of its staff and clients. An environment with driven people, who have an entrepreneurial mindset, to help support your development ambitions.

5. Your Responsibilities and Duties

5.1 Leadership Responsibilities:
5.1.1 Support the mentoring of junior members of the team of corporate secretaries and dedicated minute takers to deliver top-tier, responsive and quality focused company secretarial services commensurate with ONE's corporate culture and product offering.

• Acting as a key point of contact with clients, boards, administrators, regulators, counsel and other third parties.
• Support clients and boards with best corporate governance practice.
• Organise and attend Board, Shareholder and Committee meetings for a varied portfolio of clients.
• Take and/or review meeting minutes and resolutions.
• Facilitate and project manage transactions.
• Travel to board meetings (within Luxembourg).
• Support company incorporations.
• Prepare and submit filings with the regulator and Luxembourg Business Registers.
• Maintain corporate records and statutory registers.
• Presenting a professional image in line with our company culture: enthusiastic, upbeat and engaging.

title: Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS) (m/f)
description:
Program Manager, Instore Experience (ISX), Reverse Logistic Services (RLS)
Job ID: 10541583 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) exists to make returns effortless and reliable for every Amazon customer — no matter which store or partner they walk into. In France, we deliver that experience across more than 15,000 partner and carrier locations, through convenience-led options such as Label-Free, Box-Free (LFBF) drop-off and every other way a customer can return an item in-store.

The ISX Regional Program Manager, France owns the quality and consistency of that experience across the whole French network. Because returns run through thousands of independent partner sites, the experience can vary widely from one location to the next and the core of this role is closing that gap. You will get into the field, see how returns actually happen at partner locations, coach partners and their teams to the standard customers expect, and use data to focus your time on the sites that need help most. Your mission is holistic: improving in-store returns execution across all return types, so a customer's experience is just as good at the busiest location as it is at the smallest.

This is not only a field-execution role. It carries a strategic remit that reflects its level. Beyond coaching individual sites, you will help design and deploy the network-wide improvements that lift the entire France network at once: in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment mechanisms, associate support and training, and the tools partners rely on to process returns. You will translate what you learn in the field into scalable programs, work across internal teams to launch them in France, and help shape how the broader EU standards themselves are built, turning local, on-the-ground insight into lasting structural improvement.

This is also a founding, build-from-scratch role. You'll be the first ISX Program Manager for France and one of the earliest members of the EU field team, reporting directly to the EU ISX Senior Manager. There's no established playbook yet, you'll help create it. We're looking for someone with real ambition, comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to focus relentlessly on the initiatives that matter most while the team, tools, and standards are still taking shape.

Key job responsibilities

• Own the in-store returns experience in France across ~17,000 partner and carrier locations, ensuring returns are fast, easy, and reliable for customers across all return types.
• Get into the field and coach. Visit partner locations, observe how returns are handled, and coach partner teams to Amazon's standards for speed, accuracy, and customer experience.
• Use data to prioritize. You can't be everywhere. Use performance data to identify the locations and partners falling furthest behind and concentrate your effort where it improves the customer experience most.
• Drive measurable improvement on the metrics that define a great returns experience: how fast customers are served, how reliably returns are processed, customer satisfaction, and site readiness.
• Deploy network-wide improvements. Lead the rollout of scalable programs that raise the standard across the entire Italian network, including in-store signage and wayfinding, store supplies and replenishment, associate support and training, and returns-processing tools , using your field insight to prioritize and adapt them for the market.
• Shape strategy from the field. Turn on-the-ground observations into recommendations that influence how EU-wide returns standards, mechanisms, and programs are designed, ensuring the field perspective is built in from the start.
• Manage performance to resolution. Follow a structured coaching and follow-up cycle for underperforming sites, and partner with the right internal teams (Business Partnerships for retail partners, the Transportation team for carriers) when issues need to be escalated to a partner's leadership.
• Build the foundation. As a founding team member, help shape how the EU field team audits, coaches, and reports, adapting proven practices from the North America team to the French market and feed your field insights into the monthly ISX reporting that informs strategy.

A day in the life

You start the week by reviewing performance data for France and identifying the partner locations and carriers falling furthest behind on the customer experience. You spend time in the field visiting a risk-weighted set of those sites, watching real customers complete returns, checking that the process is running smoothly, and coaching partner teams on the spot. Back at your desk, you're also driving the French rollout of a new signage standard and a store-supplies replenishment mechanism, using what you saw in the field to shape how they're deployed. You log your findings, build improvement plans for the sites that need them, escalate the bigger systemic issues to the right internal team, and close the week by capturing insights for the monthly ISX report and re-planning around wherever the customer experience needs you most.

About the team

Reverse Logistics Services (RLS) owns the returns journey end-to-end for Amazon, everything that happens after a customer decides to send something back until delivery at our FC. Our purpose is simple but hard: make returns effortless and reliable for every customer, while running one of the largest, most complex reverse-logistics networks in retail.

Within RLS, the In-Store Experience (ISX) team focuses on where returns meet the real world, the thousands of partner and carrier locations customers walk into to drop off an item. We turn a single promise into a consistent reality across every one of them: fast, easy, dependable returns, no matter which door a customer chooses. Working from the field, we close the gap between the best and worst locations, coach partners to a standard customers can count on, and build the mechanisms that lift the whole network at once.

Our culture is hands-on, data-driven, and high-ownership. We obsess over the customer, thrive in ambiguity, dive deep into the details on the ground, and think big about how to scale what works - because the best decisions about in-store returns are made by people who've seen them happen firsthand.

- Develop roadmap to achieving total cost targets (TCO), including make vs. buy analysis and value engineering opportunities

A day in the life

A typical day involves leading PDP gate reviews, aligning DfX requirements with engineering teams, and driving supply chain readiness for hardware programs. Internal stakeholders include mechanical/electrical engineers, sourcing managers, manufacturing partners, and program managers. Customers are the robotics product lines launching new systems. The role solves problems at the intersection of design and supply — ensuring parts are sourceable, manufacturable, and available on time. Expect cross-functional stand-ups, supplier escalations, regionalization strategy sessions, and risk reviews tracking critical path components to production milestones.

About the team

The Amazon Robotics Supply Chain team provides strategic sourcing for a portfolio of robotic technologies and is responsible for delivering new products by enabling the right suppliers and technologies, and getting the right materials at the right cost to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It is a fast-paced operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon and is driven by data and metrics.

The NPI Supply Chain Product Management team develops supply chain strategies for new Fulfillment Tech and Robotics products from concept to general availability. As the central integration point between technical, commercial, and operational teams, we drive PDP adherence and comprehensive supplier readiness oversight. Our vision establishes scalable, cost-effective solutions leveraging AI-driven insights to exceed performance targets. Our mission encompasses end-to-end strategy development through data-driven decisions, comprehensive make-vs-buy frameworks, regional manufacturing strategies, and cross-functional integration with partner ops teams. We maintain accountability for product cost targets, supplier readiness metrics, and program milestones while optimizing total landed cost and operational efficiency across FTR's portfolio.

title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
description:
International Tax Senior Advisor

locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.

You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2–4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.
We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.

The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

title: Agent d'Accueil Assistance Bagages (m/f/x)
description:
Description de tâches:


Missions :

Accueillir et informer les clients pour toute question relative à leurs bagages (airside / landside)
Créer et mettre à jour les dossiers dans les systèmes informatiques et effectuer les tâches administratives afférentes
Effectuer les recherches dans les systèmes informatiques
Assurer le traitement et le dédouanement des bagages retardés / endommagés et en coordonner la livraison
Récupérer les bagages oversize et encombrants du sas et les restituer aux passagers, à l'arrivée
Récupérer les bacs à bagages du tapis roulant et en effectuer le rangement
Tenir les statistiques journalières
Occasionnellement, assister les passagers aux bornes d'enregistrement self-service, au Lounge, au Check-In et coordonner les files d'attente suivant procédures en fonction en vigueur


Profil requis:

Critères minimaux requis pour le poste

Etre détenteur d'un diplôme de fin d'études secondaires au Luxembourg ou équivalent
Maîtriser l'anglais, le français et l'allemand (parlé & écrit)
Avoir les aptitudes physiques à la manutention des bagages
Avoir de bonnes capacités relationnelles et savoir gérer des situations conflictuelles.
Etre orienté clients, avoir une présentation soignée et respecter les procédures du port d'uniforme
Travail sur tournées.


Critères souhaités ou à acquérir

Avoir des notions en luxembourgeois
Etre précis, organisé et résistant au stress
Savoir travailler de manière autonome et en équipe


Candidat idéal

Une expérience dans une fonction d'accueil de clients ou au Check-In est un atout
Toute autre langue sera considérée comme un atout


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Duties

Welcome and inform passengers regarding any baggage-related inquiries (airside / landside)
Create and update records in IT systems and carry out related administrative tasks
Perform searches in IT systems
Handle and process delayed and/or damaged baggage, including customs clearance, and coordinate delivery
Collect oversized and bulky baggage from the designated area and return it to passengers upon arrival
Retrieve baggage trays from the conveyor belt and ensure proper storage
Maintain daily statistics
Occasionally assist passengers at self-service check-in kiosks, in the Lounge and at the Check-In area, and manage passenger queues in accordance with current procedures


Minimum Requirements

Secondary school diploma obtained in Luxembourg or equivalent
Proficiency in English, French and German (spoken and written)
Physical ability to handle baggage
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to manage conflict situations
Customer-oriented mindset, professional appearance, and compliance with uniform regulations
Willingness to work in shifts


Desired or To-Be-Acquired Skills

Basic knowledge of Luxembourgish
Accuracy, strong organizational skills and ability to work under pressure
Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
Previous experience in a customer-facing role or at Check-In is an asset
Any additional language will be considered an asset


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Aufgaben

Begrüßung und Information der Passagiere bei allen Fragen rund um ihr Gepäck (Airside / Landside)
Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Datensätzen in IT-Systemen sowie Durchführung der zugehörigen administrativen Aufgaben
Durchführung von Recherchen in IT-Systemen
Abwicklung von verspätetem und/oder beschädigtem Gepäck einschließlich Zollabfertigung sowie Koordination der Zustellung
Abholung von Übergepäck und sperrigem Gepäck aus dem Schleusenbereich und Rückgabe an die Passagiere bei Ankunft
Einsammeln der Gepäckwannen vom Förderband und ordnungsgemäße Lagerung
Führung der täglichen Statistiken
Gelegentliche Unterstützung der Passagiere an Self-Service-Check-in-Automaten, in der Lounge und am Check-in sowie Koordination der Warteschlangen gemäß den geltenden Verfahren


Mindestanforderungen

Abschluss der Sekundarschulausbildung in Luxemburg oder gleichwertiger Abschluss
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Englisch, Französisch und Deutsch (in Wort und Schrift)
Körperliche Eignung für die Gepäckhandhabung
Gute soziale Kompetenzen sowie Fähigkeit, mit Konfliktsituationen umzugehen
Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung, gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild und Einhaltung der Uniformvorschriften
Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit


Wünschenswerte bzw. zu erwerbende Kompetenzen

Grundkenntnisse in Luxemburgisch
Sorgfältige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Belastbarkeit
Fähigkeit zum selbstständigen Arbeiten sowie zur Teamarbeit

title: Senior / Assistant Manager - Internal Audit (m/f)
description:
Senior / Assistant Manager - Internal Audit

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Senior / Assistant Manager in Internal Audit!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Participate actively in the realization of internal audit missions for a diversified client portfolio of the financial sector (Banks, PFS, Management Companies and Payment Institutions) under the supervision of your managers;
Identify, analyse and evaluate the internal control process in order to evaluate its relevance and efficiency;
Ensure mandates are performed in a correct manner and meet deadlines and requirements in accordance with the BDO and international/internal audit standards methodology.

This offer is for you if:

You have a Master's degree in economics, audit or controlling;
You at least 3 years of experience in Luxembourg in Internal Audit or External Audit of Banks, PFS, Management Companies or Payment Institutions;
You have been involved in risk management assignments;
You stay up to date in your knowledge of the Luxembourg and European regulatory environment applicable to financial institutions (CSSF regulations, CSSF circulars, AIFMD…);
You speak English fluently; French is considered a strong asset;
Your flexibility allows you to adapt to and manage unexpected events;
You have excellent communication and analytical skills;
You are comfortable taking ownership of your work and, depending on your experience, coordinating assignments and supporting more junior colleagues.
You have excellent client service skills including active listening, you maintain regular contacts with clients, demonstrate proactivity, and act as a problem solver in order to satisfy the client;

What's in it for you:

Competitive remuneration package including

- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus

Pension plan
Lunch vouchers
Extra days of annual leave
Flexible working hours and homeworking options
Parking spots available for a fee within our building
Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
Free access to our fitness room
Sports sessions for small additional charge
Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

title: Second de cuisine (m/f)
description:
Description:

DESCRIPTIF DE POSTE
SECOND DE CUISINE – grand café

SUPERIEUR HIERARCHIQUE : chef de cuisine

ENCADREMENT : OUI

MISSION PRINCIPALE:

Le second de cuisine est chargé de seconder le chef de cuisine dans la gestion opérationnelle de la cuisine du restaurant GRAND CAFE. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec lui dans le but d'assurer une production culinaire de haute qualité et de satisfaire les attentes des clients. Il est également responsable de la supervision d'une équipe composée de chefs de partie, de commis et plongeurs, tout en garantissant le respect des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire.

TACHES ET RESPONSABILITES:

Management:

• Il assiste le chef dans la planification et l'organisation de l'ensemble des activités quotidiennes de la cuisine
• Il supervise les chefs de partie et les commis afin d'assurer une production culinaire professionnelle et constante
• Il motive, encourage et donne le rythme à l'équipe lors du service
• Il participe activement à la formation et au suivi des membres de l'équipe, en transmettant son savoir-faire et en favorisant leur développement professionnel

Mise en place:

• Il contrôle la propreté de la cuisine et des frigos, en cas de non-respect des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité il en réfère au personnel de cuisine
• Il organise les tâches du personnel de cuisine de manière détaillée en fonction de la fiche de mise en place établie
• Il allume les fours
• Il se tient informé auprès du maitre d'hôtel du nombre de réservations pour anticiper le service à venir et l'informe de changements éventuels de carte, de portions limitées, de recommandations particulières à faire aux clients
• Il contrôle que chaque chef de partie a bien suivi sa fiche de mise en place à chaque début de service et qu'il l'a bien remplie en fin de service

Production:

• Il participe, et est force de proposition dans l'élaboration des menus, plats et fiches techniques
• Il redirige les commandes clients et leurs envois vers les différentes parties
• Il contrôle l'application de toutes les directives concernant la fabrication des plats, leur qualité et leur présentation
• Il corrige les erreurs de préparation et de présentation avant que les plats ne soient envoyés
• Il organise et contrôle l'envoi des suites de plats
• Il maintient une communication régulière avec les autres départements du restaurant, notamment le service en salle, pour garantir une coordination optimale

Hygiène – approvisionnement:

• Il applique et veille au bon respect des règles d'hygiène de sécurité alimentaire quotidiennement
• Il contrôle la propreté de l'ensemble de la cuisine : plonge, plans de travail, ustensiles, machines, sols, frigos...
• Il réceptionne les marchandises, contrôle leur température, s'assure qu'elles soient conformes aux commandes passées et les range
• Il vérifie que chaque production du jour soit étiquetée
• Il relève quotidiennement la température des frigos et contrôle les DLC en veillant à la bonne rotation des produits selon FIFO
• Il contrôle les stocks, en veillant à minimiser les pertes et le gaspillage, il effectue les commandes nécessaires auprès des fournisseurs


PREREQUIS:

• Avoir d'excellente connaissance des techniques de cuisine et méthodes de préparation
• Être doté de capacités managériales développées, une aptitude à encadrer et à motiver son équipe
• Avoir une communication claire et efficace
• Avoir un sens aigu de l'organisation, de la planification et de la gestion des priorités
• Être orienté résultats, capable de travailler efficacement dans un environnement sous pression
• Connaitre les normes d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire

Remarque:  Travail le soir possible jusqu'à 00h00

Autres compétences requises:  5 ans dans un poste identique

title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Teacher French Language B (DP and MYP) (m/f) - 6 months contract
description:
DP (Diploma Programme) and MYP (Middle Years Programme) French Language B - 6 months contract (2627-037)

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

Join Our Learning Community at ISL!

Do you believe that every learner has unique potential, and that education should nurture curiosity, critical thinking, and global awareness? Are you passionate about creating meaningful learning experiences that empower students to make sense of the world and their place in it? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

As a teacher in our school, you will play a key role in shaping not only what our students learn, but how they learn. You'll design engaging, concept-driven lessons that invite curiosity, encourage reflection, and challenge students to connect learning to their own lives — locally and globally. Teaching in our Upper School means that you will be expected to take part in the student wellbeing / advisory programme.
Why ISL?

At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:

· Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
· Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
· Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future

About the Role

At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. We are currently seeking a passionate and reflective French Language B Teacher - Diploma Programme (DP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP)- to join our vibrant learning community in Luxembourg.

As a French Language B Teacher, you will guide students in developing their language acquisition skills and intercultural understanding through the IB DP and MYP frameworks. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for a teacher who sees teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What You'll Do

As our French Language B Teacher, you will:

· Design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences in French Language B across DP and MYP
· Collaborate with colleagues to design interdisciplinary, concept-based, and innovative learning experiences
· Teach and support learners in developing French language acquisition, communication skills, and intercultural understanding
· Create inclusive, differentiated learning environments that support diverse learners
· Foster learner agency, voice, and ownership of learning
· Use assessment and feedback intentionally to guide progress and growth of learners
· Build strong, respectful relationships with learners that promote wellbeing and a sense of belonging
· Using a Learning Management System to organize course materials, support collaboration, and engage students.
· Contributing to the wellbeing and pastoral life of the school, including serving as a student advisor.
· Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
· Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
What will you bring?

Essential:

● Experience teaching IB DP French Language Acquisition and/or MYP French Language B;
● Experience preparing students for IB assessments;
● A recognised teaching qualification and relevant university degree (MA preferred);
● High-level proficiency in French appropriate for teaching Language B;
● Strong skills in inquiry-based, student-centred and differentiated teaching;
● The ability to create inclusive learning experiences for multilingual learners with diverse strengths and needs;
● Strong communication, collaboration and relationship-building skills;
● A reflective, culturally responsive and internationally minded approach to teaching and learning;
● A commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing and belonging.

Valued Experience:

● Experience preparing students for IGCSE assessments;
● Experience teaching within an international and multilingual school community;
● Experience integrating educational technology and AI thoughtfully into language learning;
● Contributions to advisory, pastoral, co-curricular or beyond-the-classroom programmes.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.

We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:

If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.

If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

CDI – Temps plein – Kleinbettingen (Luxembourg)
Rejoignez un acteur industriel engagé de l'alimentation européenne
Entreprise familiale indépendante fondée au Luxembourg, Les Moulins de Kleinbettingen est un acteur reconnu de la transformation céréalière en Europe.
Depuis onze générations, nous développons un savoir-faire solide dans la fabrication de produits destinés à l'alimentation humaine: farines, semoules, mixes et solutions alimentaires à destination des artisans, industriels et de la grande distribution.

Notre développement repose sur trois piliers essentiels:  qualité – innovation – respect des ressources naturelles

Dans le cadre du développement de nouvelles activités industrielles, nous renforçons nos équipes afin d'accompagner notre croissance et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence sur l'ensemble de nos lignes de fabrication.

Opérateur(trice) de Production Agroalimentaire (H/F)

Votre mission:

Intégrez une équipe dynamique et participez activement à la fabrication de produits agroalimentaires de qualité.
Sous la responsabilité du Chef d'équipe Production, vous contribuez à la transformation des matières premières en produits finis dans le respect des standards de qualité, d'hygiène, de sécurité et de performance industrielle.
Ce poste vous offre une réelle polyvalence au cœur de l'atelier : vous intervenez sur différentes étapes de la production et pouvez être amené(e) à occuper plusieurs postes selon les besoins. Cette diversité des tâches vous permet de développer vos compétences, de gagner en autonomie et de jouer un rôle clé dans la fluidité de la production.

Vos principales responsabilités:

Production

• Assurer la conduite et la surveillance des équipements d'extrusion.
• Effectuer le suivi des paramètres de production et signaler toute anomalie.
• Veiller au respect des objectifs de production, de qualité et de rendement.
• Réaliser les changements de production selon les procédures établies.

Contrôle qualité

• Effectuer les contrôles horaires des produits en cours de fabrication.
• Réaliser et enregistrer les résultats des contrôles dans le système de gestion de la qualité.
• Prélever des échantillons et effectuer des analyses simples au laboratoire de production:
• Identifier les écarts de qualité et informer la hiérarchie en cas de non-conformité.

Gestion des matières premières

• Assurer le vidage et l'approvisionnement des matières premières nécessaires à la production.
• Contrôler la disponibilité et la conformité des matières utilisées.
• Participer à la gestion des stocks de matières premières selon les procédures en vigueur.

Packaging et préparation de commandes

• Réaliser les opérations de conditionnement et d'emballage des produits finis.
• Vérifier la conformité de l'étiquetage et du conditionnement.
• Préparer les commandes selon les instructions de production et les exigences clients.
• Assurer la traçabilité des produits emballés.

Entretien et nettoyage

• Effectuer le nettoyage régulier des équipements, des postes de travail et des zones de production.
• Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de nettoyage en vigueur.
• Participer aux opérations de maintenance de premier niveau.

Conditions particulières

• Travail posté selon les besoins de la production.
• Port des équipements de protection individuelle obligatoire.
• Respect strict des procédures qualité, sécurité et hygiène.

Perspectives d'évolution

Ce poste offre une réelle perspective d'évolution vers une fonction de Chef d'équipe Production.
Selon votre engagement, votre maîtrise des équipements et votre capacité à coordonner les activités de production, vous pourrez progressivement évoluer vers un rôle à responsabilités comprenant:

• Encadrement opérationnel d'une équipe de production
• Organisation et suivi des plannings de fabrication
• Coordination des changements de production
• Support technique et organisationnel aux opérateurs
• Contribution active à la performance globale de la ligne

Un accompagnement interne et des formations pourront être proposés afin de soutenir cette évolution.

Compétences requises

• Formation technique, industrielle ou agroalimentaire (ou expérience équivalente)
• Une première expérience en production est un atout, mais non obligatoire
• Vous êtes rigoureux(se), impliqué(e) et appréciez le travail en équipe
• Vous avez le sens des responsabilités et de la qualité
• Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement industriel structuré

The position holder is responsible for the architecture, development and delivery of the Company's Android applications, and for the technical leadership of the mobile engineering team. Software engineering services, including:

• Design, implement and maintain software interface and infrastructure components;

• Define and maintain the architecture of the Company's Android applications, ensuring scalability, maintainability and compliance with security requirements;

You will lead data science and analytics work across analytical data models, machine learning, forecasting, experimentation, and reporting that support business and product decisions.

title: Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions (m/f)
description:
Job Title:  Risk Officer - Vistra Funds Solutions

Job Description:  
It's never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.  

At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we're absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that
 
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Risk Manager. Reporting to the Managing Director, this full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our Operations and its' growth.

Purpose of the Role

The Risk Officer supports the permanent risk management function under the direction of the Conducting Officer and contributes to the effective implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies.

The role involves monitoring investment and operational risks, overseeing risk limits and controls, supporting regulatory and internal reporting obligations, including Annex IV reporting, and ensuring timely escalation of relevant risk matters where appropriate.

The successful candidate will work closely with internal IFM functions and external stakeholders, including valuation, portfolio management delegates, compliance, and oversight functions, to promote effective risk governance and transparent communication across the organisation.

The position requires strong analytical and organisational capabilities, a good command of risk system applications and reporting tools, and a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

The Risk Officer is expected to contribute actively to the continuous development and optimisation of risk processes and controls, demonstrating flexibility, collaboration, and clear communication skills in a dynamic environment. Exposure to UCITS risk management frameworks would be considered an advantage.

Key Responsibilities

Risk monitoring for alternative investment funds

• Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the risk management framework for alternative investment funds across liquid and illiquid strategies, including risk monitoring, controls, and limit oversight.
• Perform regular risk reporting activities, including contribution to Annex IV reporting, escalation of breaches or anomalies, and maintenance of accurate risk data within risk management systems.
• Contribute to the enhancement of risk management processes, systems, and operational procedures by identifying practical improvements and supporting the implementation of efficient and scalable solutions
• Responsible of the accuracy and timeliness in the production of risk assessment, analysis and reporting including annex IV.
• Perform the monitoring of investment compliance of the AIFs
• Support the development and enhancement of internally developed risk IT tools, including testing of new reporting solutions, data aggregation processes, controls, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of risk analytics and reporting.

Client management

• Serve as a key contact for clients on risk management matters, ensuring appropriate escalation of relevant issues to senior members of the permanent risk management function. Support the delivery of regular client reporting and communication on risk exposures, risk monitoring, and related risk management matters, while responding to client queries in a timely and professional manner.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Liaise effectively with internal IFM functions including portfolio management, valuation, compliance, to ensure consistent risk governance and information flow. Present risk findings and reports to AIF senior management.
  
Attributes/Technical Skills

• Good knowledge of alternative investment fund risk management frameworks for liquid and illiquid strategies.
• Understanding of AIFMD regulatory requirements and Annex IV reporting obligations.
• Experience with risk monitoring tools, limit management systems, and risk reporting applications Knowledge of market, liquidity, counterparty, leverage, and operational risk measurement methodologies.
• Ability to analyse and interpret portfolio risk metrics and exposure reports.
• Familiarity with data aggregation, reconciliation controls, and risk data quality processes
• Exposure to user acceptance testing (UAT) and enhancement of internally developed risk systems and reporting tools
• Good command of Excel and risk reporting tools; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, or data visualisation tools would be an advantage
• Understanding of fund structures, valuation processes, and delegated portfolio management oversight within an IFM/AIFM environment
• Ability to identify control gaps and contribute to process improvement initiatives in a regulated environment.

Relevant Experience

• Minimum 3 year of experience and strong background in similar role managing risk for AIFs
• Demonstrated expertise in risk management system and reporting operations.

Education and Professional Qualification

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or relevant professional certification (e.g., GFR, FRM and CAIA) is a plus

Company Benefits:

• Bonus Plan, based on Group performance and individual performance
• 232 hours of holidays (29 days), plus public holidays;
• Lunch vouchers for the amount of 10.80 EUR (18 per month);
• Additional AXA Health Insurance of which pays 50% (Axa VitalPlus scheme);
• Participation in Pension Scheme, after 6 months as an employee;
• Reimbursement of your public transport costs up to the amount of 75 EUR per month for cross borders.

Education

·        PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Polymer/Composite Engineering or a closely related field.

·        Strong background in fibre-reinforced polymer composites and composite manufacturing.
·        Experience in carbon fibre recycling, surface treatment and/or sizing.
·        Experience in composite processing and mechanical/material characterisation.

·        Ability to independently plan, conduct and analyse experimental research.

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Senior Advisor specialised in Banking Risk Consulting !

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with our expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized service and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 42 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skill development and ownership among our team members. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect, and responsibility define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that nurtures professional development and fosters inclusivity.

In order to support the growth of our Advisory team, we are currently looking for a: Senior Advisor – Banking Risk Consulting (m/f)

What will you do?

In your role, you will:

• Be responsible for the coordination and the follow-up of different missions. In this role, you will work on assignments with focus on risk management frameworks and regulatory compliance in banking;
• Conduct modelling and validation of risk models (e.g., PD, LGD, EAD or VaR);
• Assist our clients in regulatory reporting (e.g., COREP, FINREP, ICAAP, ILAAP, IRRBB);
• Conduct a variety of analyses to support the development of client solutions (such as materiality assessments, gap analysis, reports, and recommendations for clients);
• Contribute to the preparation of proposals (project acquisition) to support business line development;
• Together with the consulting Partner, assist and foster the development of the BDO advisory Management Consulting offering;

This offer is for you if:

• You have a master's degree in management, (quantitative) finance, econometrics or related studies;
• You have at least 3 years of experience in the financial risk management and ideally in a credit institution or a consulting environment;
·         Good knowledge of risk modelling, and data management frameworks and standards (e.g., IRB, IFRS 9, IRRBB, VaR, expected Shortfall, Monte Carlos Simulation, etc.);
• Strong knowledge of banking regulations and risk frameworks (e.g., Basel, CRR, CRD, EBA guidelines and RTS);
• Good knowledge of VBA, SQL, SAS, Python or R;
• You are a fast learner and a team player with strong communication skills and problem solving skills;
• You are fluent in English. French is an asset.
… then this offer is probably made for you!

What is waiting for you:

• Become part of a global organisation with solid financial foundations, real ambition, entrepreneurial spirit and a clear strategy for growth;
• Work within a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment;
• Get attractive benefits and advantages (in-house free fitness room, canteen, homeworking, …);
• Get an extensive training plan to develop your knowledge and skills.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!
